To create sustainable smart cities, however, these technological breakthroughs present both possibilities and difficulties. The adoption of blockchain networks in smart cities is characterized by security concerns and other difficulties, which are thoroughly reviewed in this study. To create a sustainable smarter society, several important elements for the integration of blockchain & AI technologies are discussed in detail in this study. The study examines blockchain's enhanced security options by outlining the key concepts that can be used to build various blockchain-based, AI-based smart transport systems. The study also discusses the issues that remain unresolved and the direction of ongoing research, which results in new security standards and recommendations for a long-term smart city environment.

articleTitle: Improving Performance of VGG19 Model Using Dual Input Block for Skin Disease Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Skin diseases are a growing threat to humans. These diseases can cause severe damage to the skin. The damage to the skin sometimes can lead the patient to have a loss of confidence and depression. By using emerging technologies like deep learning, skin diseases can be identified and treated effectively. These computer-powered techniques can detect skin diseases without any help from a professional. People can have a user-friendly experience if some effort is put into the interface. This can help people identify the disease in its early stages instead of just ignoring it as an allergy. This will help people avoid suffering from the severe consequences of the diseases. These technologies can accurately find the disease in the patient. By using the Deep Learning algorithms like CNN, the process is simple and less time-consuming. By using advanced models like Inception Net and ResNet and optimizing the model's hyperparameters like learning rate, optimizers, etc., the model can give high performance and accuracy. The model can be trained to give accurate results even if the images used in the training dataset and the image given by the patient are of low quality. This paper proposes a dual-input CNN model to identify skin diseases. A modified VGG-19 neural network with dual input blocks and batch normalization is used to classify the diseases. The model outperforms the original VGG19 by about 5 percent. The original model, trained from scratch, was also modified to have batch normalization. The models did not learn, and the accuracy did not increase without batch normalization. The models were trained for 150 epochs. Both were trained under the same parameters and methods. The dual input model yields about 94%, while the original VGG19 architecture trained from scratch gives about 89%. The models were trained on the P100 GPU which are available in Kaggle. The model is implemented on hardware that can give results without any delay to the patient.

articleTitle: Missing Children Face Identification Using Deep Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: A toddler dies in India every 20 seconds; the majority of them are female and come from low socioeconomic backgrounds. The Supreme Court found that no one seemed to care about the children who are not in their homes, citing statistics that show that only thirty percent of them are fortunate to reach their homes. Herein lies the irony. Many of these unruly teenagers sadly find themselves being trafficked into a foreign and dangerous environment that is occasionally located far from home, where they end up working as infants, begging, staying in shelter homes, or being forced into trading. With the active support of the civil community, it is possible to ensure baby safety and address the issue of missing children. The techniques used by parents to report their missing children in a web application with manual and automatic location with resources that lost children rejoin with their families were discussed in the current study. Unlike typical deep learning applications, our technique only uses a convolutional network as high-level feature extraction and lets a trained SVM classifier perform the child recognition. After selecting the most effective Haar classification algorithm model for face recognition and properly training it, a deep learning model that is robust to noise, contrast, image pose, child age, and previous face recognition missing child identification techniques. and the police case of child death is also produced.

articleTitle: Early Stage Skin Cancer Detection Using Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Early stage malignant cancer detection has gain utmost research importance in recent times. Carcinoma, which is currently acknowledged as the deadliest form of cancer in humans, appears in various types such as skin cancer, basal cell carcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma, and the relatively unexpected malignant melanoma. Timely identification of malignant melanoma is crucial for providing effective treatment. Computer vision systems have played a significant role in medical image classification, offering valuable contributions in this field. In this study, we propose a computer-aided method that relies on images to detect melanoma, a type of skin cancer. The system takes an image of a skin lesion as input and employs innovative image processing techniques to assess and determine the presence or absence of skin cancer. By analyzing factors such as texture, size, and segmentation, lesion image analysis tools examine a wide range of features associated with melanoma, including spatial characteristics, contours, color, diameter, and more. Based on derived feature parameters, the images are classified as either indicating melanoma or representing benign skin lesions.

articleTitle: Effective Visualization and Trend Forecasting of Crime Data Through Big Data Analytics and Mining
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: A crime is an act that merits public condemnation and penalties, which is usually in the form of a fine or jail. It is a widespread social issue that affects a country's life style, economic progress, and credibility. People are at a worrisome point in terms of reducing criminal activity at a greater rate, as criminality rates have risen dramatically. If people can evaluate and predict the crime pattern and implement preventive steps ahead of time, crime rates can be lowered. In this research, the author has present Crime Cast, a system that analyses crime reports and anticipates trends and crime statistics based on a specified data set using deep learning techniques such as LSTM and DNN at a faster rate and with greater accuracy. Within a huge percentage of crime data, Big Data Analytics is utilized to analyze and detect different crime patterns, their relationships, and trends. The information contains cases of kidnapping, murder, rape, stealing, and other crimes. With the help of the LSTM model and DNN several operations performed on the data. The expected outcomes will aid police and law enforcement agencies in clearer grasp crime trends, allowing them to track incidences and improve their decision-making processes. These results will allow the law enforcement and regulatory agencies to further immediately spot inappropriate behavior issues and provide information that will allow them to monitor activities and predict the likelihood of limiting the number of events, transporting property securely, and improving the dynamic cycle.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Thresholding Framework for Detecting the Subsurface Movements in Landslide-prone Sites
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Landslides are mainly caused by heavy rainfall, soil erosion, changes in groundwater, earthquakes, and human activities such as deforestation, shifting cultivation, mining, and urbanization. Understanding surface and subsurface ground movements is crucial for developing effective landslide monitoring and early warning systems. One of the major challenges in developing such systems is the identification of the signal patterns that trigger landslides. Due to the weak nature of the landslide signals and the high interference of external noises, accurately detecting these signals can be difficult. Existing systems often rely on decision models with fixed thresholds, for event detection which may not be suitable for different landslide-prone areas. To address this issue, this paper proposes an adaptive thresholding mechanism that uses a Linear Energy-Based Detector and Gaussian Kernel to detect subsurface activities in landslide-prone sites. The onset arrivals of the subsurface activities are calculated using a recursive STA/LTA algorithm. This adaptive strategy can be used in sites with different environmental and climatic conditions and offers greater flexibility than fixed threshold systems. Using geophone sensors, the proposed methodology is tested by conducting experiments that capture subsurface ground movements caused by human footsteps and vehicular vibrations.

articleTitle: An Efficient Application of Hybrid Optimization with Deep Learning Approach in the Prediction of Cardiovascular Disease
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: The incidence of arteries and cardiovascular diseases, which result in heart failure and early deaths in the form of myocardial infarction, stroke, and fainting, is currently one of the primary causes of mortality in every country in the globe. Deep Learning (DL) has lately attracted research interest in a variety of fields, especially medical treatment, where it is being used to diagnose the cardiovascular disease early on via image processing. The methodology proposed in this work is revolutionary using a deep learning method for the premature heart disease identification and diagnosis. To reduce noise and improve image quality, the dataset must first be pre-processed using the Weiner-Frost filter. Then, Feature extraction is carried out using k-means clustering technique to retrieve the exact features for further process. The following phase involves selecting the most crucial features for predicting CVD using a hybrid lion-grey-wolf optimization algorithm, which incorporates the advantages of both techniques. A deep learning model which incorporates a convolutional neural network (CNN) and bidirectional long short-term memory (Bi-LSTM) architecture completes the categorization of CVD. The suggested method is highly accurate at identifying CVD and is a dependable technique for identifying and diagnosing CVD early.

articleTitle: House Price Rate Change Prediction Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: The real-estate market is the central tenet amongst the most focused businesses regarding pricing and it is keep fluctuating. The rate change is normal for most of the business in the real world scenario, most of the businesses will be linearly incremented not in a drastic manner, but in the real-estate sector the price change is very drastic either increment or decrement. Based on the different global and local geopolitical factors it is varying. These factors will highly influence on the price of the property. The term valuation of a property is considered as the analytical process of evaluating the net worth of the property. However, there are a wide range of factors which affect the valuation process. In prediction of the prices there are so many approaches are there based on machine learning and analytics. Majorly the regression based approaches are giving appropriate results. But in certain circumstances it is going to deviate and sudden price spike may not be reflected there. The main objective of this study is to find such rate changes along with the correlation of the global or national circumstances. The prediction or forecast the future house prices that are generated by using Linear Regression Model. Here Hyderabad region dataset is considered, which has more fluctuated rates compared to any other metropolitan cities in the past two decades.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Radio Frequency Identification Based E-Shopping Cart
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Smart shopping using RFID (Radio Frequency Identification) and Wi-Fi technology is an innovative approach to enhance the shopping experience of customers by providing them with real-time information about products. The system consists of RFID tags on the products and Wi-Fi access points installed throughout the store. The tags on the products are detected by the RFID readers installed on the access points, which then transmit the information to the customer's smartphone through the Wi-Fi network. The use of RFID and Wi-Fi technology in smart shopping carts has several advantages over traditional shopping carts. It eliminates the need for manual scanning of items at the checkout, which saves the time and reduces errors in billing also eliminates the queues. Additionally, retailers can use the data collected from the system to optimize their inventory and improve their supply chain management. Smart shopping using RFID and Wi-Fi technology has the potential to revolutionize the shopping experience by providing customers with a more convenient and personalized service while also benefiting retailers through increased sales and improved efficiency. With the increasing demand for contactless and seamless shopping experiences, the adoption of this technology is expected to grow rapidly in the near future.

articleTitle: Circumcenter Based Mobile Beacon Aided Localization in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Locating the unknown sensors with a high degree of precision in wireless sensor networks is a vital issue. The localization method suggested by various researchers focused only on the mobility of an anchor (or) beacon node. To determine the unknown node's position, mobile anchor allowed to assist the unknown sensors and focused only on minimum coverage at the border region. So, the sensors which are remotely from the mobile beacon will have inaccurate localization. The proposed circumcenter localization algorithm provides the complete coverage of all nodes at the border region and also computes its position using adjustable sensing radii. With this approach, the location error will be reduced and the location accuracy of the complete sensor node will be guaranteed Via a series of simulation steps using the NS2 simulator, the effectivenes s of the s ugges ted technique is assessed

articleTitle: Fuzzy Logic in Computer Technology: Applications and Advancements
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: The development of Fuzzy Logic has had a profound impact on the field of computing. A crucial part of any decision-making process is the use of this mathematical method for dealing with uncertainty and imprecision. In this article, it will go over what Fuzzy Logic is, how it may be used in computing, and what recent developments have been achieved in the field. The strengths and weaknesses of using Fuzzy Logic in IT are also discussed. The introduction of Fuzzy Logic into the realm of computer science was a game-changer, since it provided a robust mathematical strategy for addressing uncertainty and imprecision in decision-making. This article introduces readers to Fuzzy Logic by discussing its background, basic ideas, and potential uses in the field of information technology. Artificial intelligence, control systems, decision-making, data analysis, and image processing are just some of the many areas where Fuzzy Logic has been put to use. In addition, this article discusses contemporary developments in Fuzzy Logic, such as those in machine learning, control systems, and robotics. Although this study extols Fuzzy Logic's numerous benefits, it also addresses the method's drawbacks. Workers in the IT industry would do well to familiarize themselves with the merits and drawbacks of Fuzzy Logic, as this knowledge may inform the development of superior products. This study's overarching goal is to introduce readers to Fuzzy Logic in the context of computer technology, including its advantages and disadvantages. Fuzzy logic has been more useful in many areas of computer science and technology. Used in areas such as control systems, image processing, robotics, and decision making, fuzzy logic allows for the processing of imprecise or uncertain input. This study gives a thorough introduction to fuzzy logic in computer technology, including its history, current developments, and potential future uses. The first section of the study provides a foundational understanding of fuzzy logic, its fundamental principles, and their applications. It then presents a comprehensive literature overview on fuzzy logic, covering its origins through the most current developments in the field. Next, the study talk about how fuzzy logic may be used in situations when precise reasoning isn't required, such as in control systems, image processing, robotics, and decision making. This study gives a case study of the development and deployment of a fuzzy logic controller for an industrial robot manipulator to demonstrate the use of fuzzy logic in the context of computer technology. The outcomes demonstrate that the robot can be effectively controlled by the fuzzy logic controller, despite the existence of uncertainties and disturbances.

articleTitle: PG-Life: A Web Based Application for Paying Guest Life
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: This web application is a web service for tracking down PG (paying guests) in and around Bangalore. The main objective of this research work is to deliver the finest PG services for students or clients and People have a long-lasting relationship than anything in the world. Right from the primitive era to the current day, there has been a need for lodging. In the current scenario, people often find themselves in a place where they look for accessibility and affordability. Proposed work PG-Life thrives to solve and revolves around this issue where there has been a lot of competence and people find themselves in a thinner space of choice. Users also can take a look at different characteristics of the information provided like location in map's, diet, fee, conveyance facility, and even safety measures, and select the best PG of their choice. Also, cost efficiency will also be taken into consideration and sometimes might even be the factor for approval. After considering all the possible scenarios and chances a web application is presented that emphasizes making people's life easier.

articleTitle: YogMaster: Detection and Correction of Yoga Postures Using Augmented Reality
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Yoga is becoming increasingly popular due to its positive effects on the body and mind. Although many individuals engage in yoga practices, it is important to use proper instruction from an experienced instructor to avoid potential health issues. The proposed solution aims to address this issue by developing a web-based application that uses a camera to capture the user's yoga poses. The TensorFlow MoveNet model then processes the captured images which identifies 17 key body points. This information is then fed to a Neural Network model for Classification which verifies the accuracy of the pose and if necessary, provides correction through a Correction model. The user will be alerted to any corrections through both visual and audio cues. The results demonstrate that the model has 99.47% accuracy.

articleTitle: Development of Efficient Wireless Sensor Network for IoT Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: This research study provides an overview of the effort that went into developing reliable “Wireless sensor networks” for IoT applications, including both theoretical study and practical testing. The report also includes the findings of an analysis of variance and regression analysis, which pinpoint the significance of such aspects as network architecture, traffic load, and ambient conditions on the performance of Wireless Sensor Network (WSN). Finally, study provides a discussion on the future research directions, as well as the design and implementation of a Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) for Internet of Things (IoT) applications.

articleTitle: Hybrid Approach for the Classification and Detection of Brain Tumors
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Hyperspectral analysis is a highly complex that supposes the development of algorithms with an enormous computational cost. The practical application of hyperspectral analysis requires the parallelization of said algorithms if it is to provide results in real time, using high-performance and massively parallel processing platforms that allow reducing execution times. In this learning, the potential of hybrid Hyperspectral image classification approaches is demonstrated. In the analysis of spectral information to identify histological samples affected by tumor tissue, the current proposal integrates HSI linear decomposition algorithms with classification methods such as neural networks. The outcomes demonstrate the usefulness of the proposed technique for the classification of histological tissue samples, producing significant accuracy in the analyzed images.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Power Electronics and Control Techniques for Renewable Energy Integration in Smart Grids
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: The development of smart grid technology for more effective and sustainable energy management has been prompted by the growing use of renewable energy sources like solar and wind power. In order to integrate renewable energy sources into the grid, power electronics and control approaches are essential. The purpose of this study is to examine the pros and cons of the various power electronics and control approaches now in use for integrating renewable energy sources into smart grids. The development of smart grid technology for more effective and sustainable energy management has been facilitated by the use of renewable energy sources like solar and wind power. When it comes to incorporating renewable energy sources into the grid, power electronics and control approaches play a crucial role. This article provides a comprehensive analysis of the literature on the topic of renewable energy integration in smart grids, with a particular focus on power electronics and control strategies. The study is based on a review of relevant literature and an analysis of the benefits and drawbacks of each method. Efficiency, dependability, cost-effectiveness, scalability, and compatibility with various renewable energy sources are some of the characteristics included in the comparison study. The research shows that each method has advantages and disadvantages, and that the choice of method is context-specific. The work has significant significance for the field of electrical and computer engineering and aids in the development of more efficient and sustainable energy management systems for the future smart grid.

articleTitle: Transforming Traditional Medical Appointment Booking with Advanced Technologies and User-Centric Design
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Life gets too busy to go to a doctor in character and keep up with the right hospital therapy. The most important motive of this work is to offer patients quite simple and luxurious experience during the appointment with the physician, as well as to addressing the questions that the sufferers provide during the appointment. The Find-My-Doctor acts as a client, and is maintained with the aid of an internet site that acts as a server and at the same time a database containing medical records, doctors, patients, and appointment statistics. The present-day widespread working procedures for registering patients and making appointments are time-eating and extremely cumbersome. Find-My-Doctor is an internet-based application designed to streamline the appointment procedure for more than one scientific/healthcare institution.

articleTitle: Multispeaker and Multilingual Zero Shot Voice Cloning and Voice Conversion
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: This research study presents an integrated model for voice cloning and voice conversion, trained on English and French using the Open SLR Multilingual LibreSpeech Datasets. Voice cloning involves synthesizing the voice of a desired person from text, while voice conversion modifies the voice of a source speaker to resemble a target speaker. The proposed model combines spectrum-prosody-cycleGAN for voice conversion and utilizes speaker encoders, decoders, attention mechanisms, and a WaveNet-based WaveGAN vocoder for voice cloning. Additionally, the study focuses on zero-shot voice cloning and voice conversion, demonstrating promising results without explicit training on the target person's voice. This work opens avenues for efficient and versatile speech modification applications.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Safety of LPG Storage Through the Implementation of Safety Instrumented Systems with IoT Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: The safe storage of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) is a major concern due to its flammable and explosive nature. The objective of this research is to enhance the safety of LPG storage through the implementation of Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS) with IoT technology. The study was carried out at the Indian Oil Corporation Limited LPG bottling plant in Ernakulum, India. A comprehensive safety system was designed and implemented that included various sensors such as area level indicators, gas monitoring systems, remote operating valves, and temperature gauges. The sensors were integrated with the IoT network, allowing for real-time monitoring and control of the LPG storage process. The results showed that the sensors accurately detected the process level, providing a high level of safety and security for the storage and handling of LPG. In addition to real-time monitoring, the system also provided remote access to the LPG storage process, enabling plant operators to monitor and control the process from a remote location. This increased the level of operational efficiency and reduced the risk of human error, thereby improving overall safety and security. The system was also equipped with advanced alarms and shutdown features that automatically trigger in case of any emergency situations, providing an additional layer of safety. The implementation of the SIS with IoT technology significantly improved the safety and security of the LPG storage process at the Indian Oil Corporation Limited LPG bottling plant in Ernakulum. The system accurately detected and monitored the process level, providing real-time data and control, and enabling the plant operators to respond quickly to any potential safety issues. The results of this study demonstrate the potential of SIS with IoT technology to improve the safety and security of LPG storage and handling processes, and it is recommended that this technology be implemented in other LPG storage facilities.

articleTitle: Deep Learning for Classification and Growth Prediction of Turmeric and Sugarcane Crops
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: The management of agricultural output and the formulation of agricultural policies, which affect the stability of the nation and society, both heavily depend on crop yield. Access to crop spatial distribution in real time is essential because of this. This study gathered information mostly from SENTINEL-2A satellite and developed a system for classifying crops primarily on phenological variables that were compared and analysed, as well as picture segmentation techniques. The profound principle of this method is to first use training data to generate a standard phenological feature sequence (SPFS) for each crop, and then use the compartmentalized test data and the vegetative growth pattern for every crop to determine the kind of surface features by calculating similarity coefficient between two sets of data. The findings indicate that phenological features and feature selection are valuable in enhancing crop generalization performance, with the generalization ability on a cross basis being 76.06%. For agricultural monitoring, multispectral SAR data have significant promise.

articleTitle: Convolutional Neural Network Algorithm for Lung Cancer Identification from X-Ray Images
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: There are many distinct ailments that have caused different difficulties to the society. Out of those diseases, cancer has shown the foremost devastating results. Researchers have proposed that cancer may be identified in its early stages and may be prevented by conducting research and looking into the disease's pattern of growth. In this research, a hybrid method of detection, extracting further to classify the various lung cancers using deep learning technique has been proposed. First, datasets of various carcinomas are acquired, and then the dataset images are labelled using feature extraction. Deep learning, a latest branch of AI which can facilitate to boost the performance of Convolutional Neural Network-based systems has been employed.

articleTitle: Hand Gesture Vocalizer using MobileNetV2 for Deaf Mutes
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: To demonstrate communication or interaction with the Deaf and Mute public is difficult nowadays. Gestures are the physical movement form enacted by an individual to transmit some significant information. There are diverse signs which express convoluted meanings and recognizing them is a challenging task for normal people who have no understanding of the sign language. With the quick evolution of technologies, some techniques can be used to identify hand gestures and transform them into voice and text. This document presents the strategy that would assist our assignment in recognizing the various signs. The pictures of both hands are loaded during runtime. This process has been acquired by concerning one user. The images will be apprehended initially and accumulated in the manually and lately caught images and characteristic extraction will be done to determine which indications has been communicated. It consists of two phases: Hand Gesture Recognition and Conversion.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Machine Learning Techniques Applied in Early Prognosis of Diseases in Healthcare: A Review Paper
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: In 21st century there has been significant rise in chronic diseases and other health related problems, and the data in the healthcare industry has significantly grown. Healthcare data is voluminous and difficult to manage by using traditional tools. Machine learning is brought into the picture by the requirement for smart decision support systems that can empower clinicians to make better choices by applying different algorithms. This study provides an overview of the various types of healthcare data in addition to analysing the work of numerous researchers based on the efficiency for illness prediction and early detection of high-risk diseases using machine learning techniques. Support Vector Machine (SVM), Random Forest, Decision Trees (DT), K- Nearest Neighbor (KNN), Deep Learning, Naive Bayes (NB), Artificial Neural Network (ANN), and Logistic Regression were the Machine Learning methods that were most commonly referenced. Algorithms, datasets, accuracy, and research gaps are the main factors taken into account.

articleTitle: Water Quality Sensor based on IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: A vital resource in our daily life is water. The quality of the water can be detected by checking the total Dissolved Solids (TDS) in it. TDS represents the amount of organic or inorganic diffused contents in water. The contents can be either in the molecular form or iodized form. It gives the percentage of solids dissolved in a specific volume of water, expressed as ppm. The water can be from a variety of sources, including rivers and industrial waste water. Each water category has a different purity level. The chemicals added for water treatment, chemical fertilizers used in gardens, and plumbing contribute to TDS. Water is a universal solvent that readily attracts contaminants and can quickly absorb and dissolve them. Before using the water, it is mandatory to check the purity level of the water. A smart TDS measurement system is proposed here, which monitors the water quality and displays it.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Enhanced Content Management Systems: Integration, Considerations, and Useful Examples
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: This research study analyzes how content management systems (CMS) can incorporate artificial intelligence (AI). At the outset, the idea of a CMS and its significance in managing digital material are introduced. The research paper goes on to discuss various methods for incorporating AI into CMS, such as content recommendations, natural language processing, image and video analysis, chatbots and virtual assistants, content generation and optimization, data analytics and insights, intelligent search and tagging, and content moderation. The following important considerations must be made when integrating AI into CMS: defining objectives, data accessibility, data privacy and security, AI expertise, scalability and performance, user experience, ethical considerations, testing and assessment, maintenance, and upgrades. The suggested method offers real-world examples, such integrating AI services or creating unique AI modules for well-known CMS choices like Strapi. In order to achieve a successful integration that improves user experiences and content management procedures, the essay emphasizes the significance of careful planning, moral implementation, and continuing maintenance.

articleTitle: Drowsy Driver Alert System Using OpenCV
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Drowsy driving is a significant reason for road accidents that can lead to serious injuries and fatalities. To address this issue, a drowsy driver alert system using OpenCV is proposed. The system uses computer vision algorithms to analyze facial features and detect signs of drowsiness in drivers. It generates visual and auditory alerts to prompt the driver to take necessary actions. In this research work, the design and implementation of the drowsy driver alert system is presented using OpenCV. The study describes the system architecture, which includes a camera, microcontroller, sensors, computer vision algorithms, an alert system, and an alert customization interface. Also provides a detailed explanation of the working of the system, including image processing and feature extraction algorithms used to detect signs of drowsiness.

articleTitle: Optimization Technique to Reduce Resource Utilization of Software Key Loggers Using PSO
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Software key loggers are the leading type of keylogging. Both cheap and consumer-specific and specially created keylogging programs are easily accessible online. These key loggers should be revised to each target operating system to guarantee the appropriate handing of I/O devices. Therefore, system differences inevitably initiate operating system-based devices of software key loggers: keyboard state tables, system routine hooks, and the adoption of kernel-mode layered drivers. It is analyzed that software key logger has high execution time and resource utilization. In this research work, the PSO technique is applied which will optimize the software key loggers. The proposed model is implemented in MATLAB and results are analyzed in terms of execution time, resource utilization.

articleTitle: Real Time Object Detection based on RCNN Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: This research provides a method for recognizing objects in real-time on any model-enabled device, regardless of the environment. In computer vision, object identification and training are thriving, all-encompassing, and elusive areas. CNN are used in this study to develop a multi-layered model for categorizing items into specified classes. Following object identification, the proposed algorithms assign a class label by assessing many photographs. These things are identified using more comprehensive feature maps. Recent advances in deep learning for image processing have made this possible. Such images might be found in the video frames used to train the model. Multi-scale feature maps are used for detection and filters, each of which has separate default boxes so that various aspect ratios can be accomodated. The training continues until there is a discernible reduction in the error rate. The performance of the trained model is used to evaluate test images. Proposed object recognition method employs a single-shot multi-box detector methodology and a faster region CNN architecture. This helps us to improve object detection method's computational efficiency and proposed model can identify and classify the given input image data more accurately.

articleTitle: A Survey of Key Challenges in Integrating IoT and Cloud Security
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) and its security has gained the attention of various researchers in recent times The present government, public or organizations depend upon the technology while comparing to 19<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> century. So per better quality and development of technology we need public needs and requirements. To find that requirement we need some IOT tools The Internet of Things (IoT) refers to a group of tangible items, such as structures, machines, and automobiles, that have been outfitted with electronic components, software programs, and sensing apparatuses. These entities are capable of gathering and sharing data as they are linked to the internet. IoT is transforming the way companies do business by connecting people, processes, data, and things to create a more intelligent and efficient environment. IoT is used in many applications, such as smart homes, connected cars, and smart cities. IoT security is a key concern for businesses, as connected devices are vulnerable to malicious attacks. Security measures must be taken to protect the data and prevent unauthorized access. These measures include encryption, authentication, and access control. Companies should also use measures such as vulnerability scans and patch management to ensure that all devices are secure. Additionally, businesses should be aware of any potential security risks associated with new technologies. By taking the necessary steps to secure IoT devices, businesses can ensure that they are protected from malicious attacks.

articleTitle: Left Ventricle Segmentation in Cardiac MR Images Using Deep Neural Network Models
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: The established method for evaluating the functioning state of the heart is magnetic resonance imaging. In order to accurately measure the heart's volumetric functional properties, left ventricular (LV) segmentation is crucial. Traditional manual analysis takes time and is dependent on the observer. In order to enhance the clinical workflow of heart functional measurement, automated segmentation algorithms are required. In this study, the left ventricle was segmented using deep learning architectures, U-Net and Multires U-Net, using 1201 short axis cardiac MR images from the MICCAI (Medical Image Computing and Computer-Assisted Intervention) 2017 challenge database. Performance indicators like Dice coefficient, accuracy, and the number of trainable parameters were used to compare the findings. U-Net is created using Fully Convolutional Networks (FCN), while Multires U-Net is built using convolutional layers in an encoder-decoder fashion. The decoder up samples the image using techniques like transpose convolution to produce the cardiac ventricle segmentation, while the encoder down samples the image using strided convolution to create a compressed feature representation of the image. Convolutional blocks are replaced by Multires blocks in the Multires U-Net design, which is a variation of the U-Net architecture. Dice coefficients of 0.9372 and 0.9575, respectively, were reached in the U-Net and Multires U-Net designs. Multires U-Net based designs could be used to segment the left ventricle and offer better analysis.

articleTitle: Real-Time Battery Equalization Circuitry for Series Battery Packs with Inverse-Excitation Type Multi-directional DC-DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: This research work focuses on the management of battery packs and proposes an automatic battery capacity equalization circuitry along with its implementation method. The circuitry employs a flyback multi-directional DC-DC converter as the main equalization circuitry to facilitate the transfer of electric energy for equalization. A relay is utilized to establish the connection between the batteries requiring equalization and the flyback multi-directional DC-DC converter. Additionally, a microprocessor is employed for battery state detection, equalization control, and other related tasks. The proposed automatic battery capacity equalization circuitry operates by cyclically detecting the capacity of each battery using a Microprogrammed Control Unit (MCU). The two batteries with the highest and lowest capacities are connected to the ends of the flyback multi-directional DC-DC converter. The high-capacity battery is then used as an input to perform equalizing charging, either in a constant current or constant voltage mode, on the low-capacity battery until its capacity reaches the average value of the battery pack. Compared to conventional battery equalization circuitry, the automatic battery capacity equalization circuitry offers simplified equalization processes, strong controllability, high speed, and high efficiency.

articleTitle: An Empowered Intuitionistic Fuzzification Trust Oriented Approach to Handle Broadcast Storm Problem for Emergency Message Transfer in VANET
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: One of the rapidly expanding research areas with significant benefits for vehicle communication and vehicular adhoc networks is the intelligent transportation system (V ANET). It is the hardest task to provide quality of service during emergency data transfer because of the dynamic and mobility character of vehicle communication, which causes broadcast storm problems due to the large volume of rebroadcast. In this study, emergency data aggregation is used to efficiently manage the broadcast storm problem. To accomplish it, clustering and cluster head selection are suggested to provide secure communication between mobile nodes in the VANET. The cluster head is crucial in rebroadcasting alert messages created by its cluster members and transmitting them to other cluster heads that are heading towards its zone. The lack of consistency and ambiguity in resolving broadcast storm issues in the presence of outliers and border lying vehicles closer to the transmission zone is a problem for conventional clustering techniques. Inadequate cluster head selection also causes end-to-end delays, limited throughput, and high energy consumption. In order to represent each vehicular node in terms of membership grade and non-membership grade and to determine the degree of hesitancy of all nodes belonging to all clusters to transfer limited rebroadcasting of alert messages without compromising reachability, the proposed work adopted intuitionistic fuzzification. While transferring emergency messages in VANET, the quality of service is improved by selecting prospective cluster heads with reduced rebroadcast. The level of hesitation gives more details on how to obtain the maximum reliability in rapid transmission. The potential candidate cluster heads are found using the intuitionistic fuzzy inference model, and the potential cluster heads are then selected for each cluster to avid broadcast storming. While choosing candidate level cluster heads, the trust factor, or level of security, is also taken into consideration. The simulation results demonstrated that, in comparison to other existing clustering algorithms, the Empowered Intuitionistic fuzzification based Trust Oriented Clustering (EIFMTC) proposed for Emergency Data Transfer in VANET offers rapid transfer with least rebroadcast of alert messages.

articleTitle: Network Scalability Analysis of Distance-Vector and Link-State Routing Algorithms: A Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Interior gateway routing protocols play a crucial role in ensuring the smooth functioning of most forms of networks that exist today including the internet, and among them, Distance-Vector-Routing-Protocol (DVRP) and Link-State-Routing-Protocol (LSRP) are extensively used. This study aims to compare the scalability performance of these two protocols. It employed the Network Simulator 2 (NS2) to evaluate the two protocols on parameters such as throughput, average packet delay, and packet loss which play a major role in determining network scalability. It was simulated on networks of varying sizes and traffic loads to determine how effectively each protocol scales with the growth of network size and traffic. Also, the link failures have been simulated to ensure that the findings of this study remain relevant in real-world scenarios. In this study, it was observed that LSRP performs better than DVRP in terms of throughput and average packet delay as network size and traffic are increased. This analysis offers valuable insights into the scalability of the two given protocols, aiding in the selection of the appropriate protocol based on specific network conditions to enhance overall network performance. It concludes that LSRP outperforms DVRP as a network scales up.

articleTitle: Technological Powered Impersonation in MOOC Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Massive Open Online Courses (MOOCs) have become a subset of Learning Management Systems (LMSs), however it doesn't appear the teacher has much of an impact upon those tools or even none at all. These efforts failed to provide tailored guidance that acknowledges the unique distinctions and requirements of the participants and instead deliver the educational topic and assets to all participants in the session in a consistent manner. Due to reports, these issues could be solved by building the next era of adaptive blended learning. This article analyses how Industry 4.0 capabilities may be included inside MOOCs. This article offers MOOCs 5.0 that are being created utilising Industry 4.0 principles of the Internet of Things (IoT) and Artificial Intelligence (AI). These qualities include improved equality of opportunity, higher engagement, active learning, better coordination, protection, & inquisitive. Additionally, these new tools will provide instructional investigators the chance to examine students' teaching methods and identify areas anywhere along learning curves wherein learners from varying backgrounds might need different support. The use of AI and IoT in MOOC academia is also considered in terms of ethical issues. Numerous proposals for the creation of innovative MOOCs were generated in line with both the research's findings.

articleTitle: ATM Assisting Device for Secure Transactions using GSM Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Automated Teller Machines (ATMs) are often targeted by hackers who use skimmers to obtain customers card information and personal identification numbers (PINs). To address this issue, a novel ATM security system is proposed that generates a temporary password using a vibrator. This temporary password is added to the customer's normal PIN and must be entered every time when the money is withdrawn. By using vibrator to generate the temporary password, it is ensured that it is unique and cannot be easily replicated. Even if a hacker obtains the temporary password along with the customer's normal PIN, they cannot access the cash without reentering the temporary password, which is only valid for a limited time. Moreover, proposed system is designed to detect and alert the owner in the event of theft. If the temporary password is entered incorrectly more than once, the system will activate an alert mechanism and shut down the shutter automatically. This will prevent the thief from accessing the cash, and notify the owner of the attempted theft. To further enhance security, the proposed method incorporates a mechanism to alert the police in case of theft. Once the shutter is shut down, it can only be opened by authorized personnel such as the police, ensuring that the cash is kept safe until the authorities arrive.

articleTitle: Finger Print Voting System Using Minutiae Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Android applications are used in the development of the Smart Voting System. Each voter's facial image, finger print, and voter ID are required by the programme in order to guarantee their individuality in the system. The election committee's manual labour is decreased by this system enables easy voting and authenticates the voter to prevent loitering or voting fraud. It guarantees that the voting process cannot be changed by an unauthorized individual. Using gathered data that is kept in a centralized database data, the voter authentication may be done in real time. The suggested dual authentication method employs facial detection as its second level of verification after verifying the finger print as its first stage. The security of the voter data is another priority for this smart voting system. By requiring all citizens to register to vote even after being mobilized, this helps to increase the voting rate.

articleTitle: IoT Based Multi-Level Remote Controlled Security System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Ensuring home security has always been a significant concern for people, and numerous methods have been attempted to tackle this issue. However, these methods have had their limitations. To address these shortcomings, the Internet of Things (IoT) has been used. Home automation allows for the automatic control of various household activities using technology to handle tasks that would otherwise require manual intervention. These activities range from detecting intruders in the middle of the night to performing everyday tasks. The IoT Hardware involved here is ESP8266 Wi-Fi module, GSM module and PIC 16F887. ESP8266 module can be used to access the internet via Wi-Fi. GSM module is used to receive calls if there are any suspicious activities. In this module the necessary code is written and loaded onto the PIC with the help of MPLAB. Back control can be done using Adafruit io which is a cloud service. IR sensors are essential to the working of the system. These IR sensors are placed in different homes which are then connected to a single microcontroller and upon receiving any signals from the IR sensor, the system intimates the respective owner in case of home being theft and the required action will be taken by the house owner with help of ESP8266 and Adafruit software.

articleTitle: Beyond Face Value: Identifying Irony and Sarcasm in Short Texts Through Multiclass Classification Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: This research study presents a comparative analysis of multiclass classifiers for detecting irony and sarcasm in short texts. With the increasing use of social media, it has become important to develop accurate and efficient algorithms for detecting irony and sarcasm, which are often expressed implicitly in text. This study has evaluated five multiclass classifiers, including Naive Bayes, linear classifier, XG Boost, KNN, and SGD, using different text representations, such as count vectors, word-level TF-IDF, and hash vectors. The results showed that the linear classifier using word-level TF-IDF achieved the highest accuracy of 74.39%, while the KNN classifier using hash vectors achieved the highest accuracy of 75.16%. However, all classifiers exhibited sensitivity to certain keywords and phrases, indicating the need for further research to improve the robustness of the classifiers. This study provides insights into the strengths and weaknesses of different multiclass classification approaches for detecting irony and sarcasm in short texts, which can guide future research in this field.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach Towards Fashion Trend Analysis System Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Fashion is one of the most important aspects of people's lives and is widely considered as a significant aspect of personal expression and identity. With the growing trend of ecommerce and online shopping, the development of fashion recommendation systems has become increasingly important. These systems aim to provide personalized fashion recommendations to customers based on their individual preferences, style, and previous purchasing history. This research work provides an overview of the current state of fashion recommendation systems, including the various algorithms and technologies used, as well as their potential benefits and limitations. This research paper proposes the development of a fashion recommendation system that utilizes machine learning algorithms to suggest outfits to users. The system will analyze user preferences and past purchases to generate personalized recommendations. The study aims to evaluate the effectiveness of the system by conducting a user study, comparing its performance to traditional online shopping experiences. The findings of the research suggest that the proposed recommendation system provides an efficient and effective way for users to discover new fashion items that match their personal style and preferences. The research also identifies potential areas for improvement and future research in the field of fashion recommendation systems.

articleTitle: Exploratory Data Analysis: An Analysis on Geotagged Twitter COVID Data
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Exploratory data analysis is the need to analyze data in depth. It comprises of basic methods like spot anomalies, stemming, hypothesis testing, check assumptions and visualize data. The sentiment analysis is a main function of exploratory analysis of data which is carried out along with keyword extraction is mentioned in the paper. The main objective of this proposed work is carried out by analyzing the twitter COVID-19 data. The pandemic played a major role in every living thing and so did it spread through the whole world by means of social media. The spread of the information is gathered here by using exploratory data analysis in python programming.

articleTitle: Camera Model Identification with Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: With the recent developments in multimedia, the forging of images has become an increasing threat for forensics. This study proposes a method using deep learning to trace an image back to its source camera model. In this study the classification performed for a set of 7 camera models but it is extendable and can be used between any numbers of models. It depends on training data given to the algorithm. Two techniques were used for simulations; Dense Neural Networks (DNN) and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN). Both of these are state of the art techniques yield a strong model. In results the comparison of both the techniques are shown. Result has shown that CNN provides more accurate results.

articleTitle: An effective Image-based Improved Deep Neural Network Framework for Coal and Gangue Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: In coal power plants, gangue is a by-product that is not wanted, even though coal is the energy source utilized the most worldwide. As a consequence of this, the removal of gangue from coal during the pre-processing stage of the mining technique is an essential step. With the development of new computer technologies, a method may be discovered that will allow for an improvement in the efficiency of gangue separation. This study presents a method for identifying gangue using improved deep neural networks. The method involves building a coal-gangue filtration system based on the distinctions between gangue and coal in terms of its rough surface and grayscale feature. In addition, this tactic will make it possible for robots, rather than people, to identify the gangue. Suppose the technology described in this article is applied in the coal industry. In that case, it will lead to the computerization of the extraction of coal gangue, an increase in the raw coal processing efficiency, and an improvement in the quality of the coal. According to the findings of experiments, the strategy enhances the accuracy results of coal and gangue materials by as much as 98.87% compared to the currently used approaches.

Author Keywords: image recognition and Deep neural network

articleTitle: Smart Environment Monitoring Using Internet of Things and Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: With the advent of sophisticated technologies, big data, and the internet of things (IoT), environmental supervision has evolved it in to a smart environment monitoring (SEM) technology in recent decades. In light of that one, the current work seeks to complete a thorough assessment of meaningful advances and scientific researches on SEM that focus on the environmental monitoring, pollution levels, radiation contamination, or agricultural systems. In this study, tools rely on big data and the Internet of Things (IoT) for sensing devices is reviewed. The objective is to pinpoint the main application domains, modern developments, data structures, and persistent problems in these areas. The findings show that big data and IoT technology convergence opens up intriguing possibilities for actually smart corresponding input for detecting, safeguarding, and enhancing environmental capital. As a beginning point for future scientific research in IoT technology and surroundings, the study sums up the techniques most frequently utilised in big data & IoT as last step.

articleTitle: A Novel Dairy Supply Chain Portal for Prediction of Milk Requirement
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: The dairy industry plays a crucial role in the economic development of India, particularly for small-scale farmers and milk societies. However, milk societies face numerous challenges in managing milk production and distribution, including predicting demand. In response, a system was developed to connect farmers with milk societies. Four models were employed to predict weekly milk demand. All models performed well, with SARIMA proving to be the most accurate based on RMSE and MAE metrics. The SARIMA model was fine-tuned with an order of (1, 1, 2) and a seasonal order of (1, 1, 1, 52) to improve its predictive accuracy. Furthermore, an online portal for milk societies to manage farmers and a mobile app for farmers to sign up were created as part of the system. By improving the milk production and distribution processes of small milk societies and ensuring prompt delivery of milk, this system has the potential to empower these societies.

articleTitle: An Overview on Breast Cancer Detection & Classification Methods Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Breast cancer is a prevalent and deadly disease that primarily affects women. Breast cancer has claimed the lives of many people all over the world. Early breast cancer detection, on the other hand, can significantly improve a woman's chances of survival. There are various approaches and procedures for detecting cancer in breast tissue. Breast cancer may be detected using Image Processing, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning methodologies and techniques. People who use trustworthy techniques and make better selections will be able to discover breast cancer in its early stages and save a woman's life. This research aims to contemplate and make inferences from diverse studies on the subject of classification using Machine Learning approaches. The researchers and physicians who devote their time and expertise to enhancing breast cancer screening methods will definitely profit from this research study.

articleTitle: Association between Students English Proficiency Exam Score and their Parental Education Level Using Chi-Square Test
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Support and Compliancy from parents towards teacher helps a lot to bond, be aware of and work towards child. Parents are also called the first “GURU” for children. As mother language is very easy to understand by any children because of frequent usage in home. In India “Hindi” is our mother language. The students who want to study in some of the foreign countries must know English language. According to records it is found that approximately 1.3 to 1.4 billion Indian students applied for English proficiency exams to further study in foreign universities in the year 2022. It is also found that the average Indian student score of English proficiency is 5.5 to 6 bands. In this paper the author wants to study the impact of Students parental education on their English reading and writing score. Author takes a data sample of 1000 graduate students who applied for the English proficiency exam available in kaggle.com. The objective of study is to find that there is any relationship between independent (Reading/Writing score) factor and dependent (Parental education) using the Chi-Square test of independence. The results of the research showed Indian students' reading/writing score of English proficiency exam is dependent on their parental education at 1% level of significance.

articleTitle: Multispectral Satellite Image Dehazing and Pollution Estimation
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Since the introduction of computer vision, the difficulty of image dehazing exist. Due to the presence of numerous air particles, which causes hazed photos, images taken during bad weather circumstances sometimes appear to be of inferior quality. To eliminate haze from the photos, this study uses a static technique called dark channel before. Ground based air pollution sensors give regular readings but have limited coverage. Satellites offer broad global coverage but poor spatial resolution and insufficient data on the vertical distribution of pollutants. It is not easy to estimate the concentrations of pollutants at the surface, where they are produced. In order to address this problem, a framework has been developed. This research work focuses on providing an approach incorporating the dehazing of a multispectral satellite picture and providing a pollution range of the region by estimating the percentage of nitrogen oxides.

articleTitle: Controller Circuitry Design for a Voltage Dropping Type Power Factor Corrector
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: This research focuses on the development of a controller circuitry for a voltage dropping type power factor corrector. The circuit is designed to control a voltage dropping converter, enabling it to effectively perform power factor correction. By employing an inductance current critical intermittent control technique, the on-time of a switching tube in a Buck circuit is modulated to align with the power frequency period and the increase in input voltage. Furthermore, the critical intermittent working mode of inductance current is controlled, allowing for resonance between the junction capacitance of the switching tube and the inductance when the inductance current is greater than zero. The switching tube is then connected when the voltage resonance of the junction capacitance reaches the volley bottom. The proposed controller circuitry offers the following characteristics: high power factors throughout the entire input voltage range, compliance with the harmonic requirements of IEC 61000-3-2 Class C and Class D, and high overall efficiency.

articleTitle: Disease Identification Using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Coconut palms are one of the most significant crops in tropical countries, supplying food and a living for millions. Coconut trees, on the other hand, are subject to a variety of diseases that can severely diminish yield and even cause mortality. Deep learning approaches have yielded promising achievements in the field of picture recognition and classification in recent years. In this study, a deep learning-based approach is proposed for identifying coconut tree diseases. Based on photographs of the tree leaves, the system is conceived and developed to automatically diagnose the disease affecting the coconut tree. The proposed system consists of three stages: pre-processing, feature extraction, and classification. To increase the quality of the input image, the pre-processing stage includes image scaling, normalisation, and enhancement. A deep convolutional neural network is used in the feature extraction stage to extract useful features from the pre-processed image. Finally, a softmax classifier is used in the classification stage to categorise the retrieved features into several types of coconut tree diseases. The suggested system is tested using a publically accessible dataset of coconut tree disease photos, and the experimental findings show that the proposed system is effective and efficient at accurately recognising the diseases that harm coconut plants. The suggested approach can be utilised by farmers, researchers, and agricultural specialists to quickly and reliably diagnose diseases affecting coconut trees, resulting in early and effective disease control and prevention measures.

articleTitle: Industrial Safety Management System Using Wireless Communication Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: The industrial safety management scheme is essential now-a-days due to the drastic growth of industries in the globe. The industrial accidents are majorly caused due to the power problems and power leakages. For ensuring the safety of human lives there is a necessity of new system to provide proper safety to guard the workers from electrical leakages or problems. When an electric current flows through a living organism, it causes a condition known as an electric shock. One milliampere is the smallest current a person can likely detect (mA). Tingling is the mildest symptom; more severe effects include muscular spasms, tissue damage, cardiac fibrillation, consciousness loss and sometimes even death. Electrocution is the term used to describe the result of a fatal electric shock. The complete power unit of a plant or department may be controlled by an embedded assisted shock prevention method, protecting workers from electrical shocks. This system provides the proper safety mechanism to industries and avoids accidental scenarios in proper way as well as the resulting section provides the outcome efficiency of the proposed approach in clear manner.

articleTitle: Strategies and Tools for Secure Path Navigation of the Visually Impaired
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: It might be difficult to assist the blind person in walking and to lead him to his goal. The challenge is helping those who are blind see the road while using human language as the sole means of communication. The blind guide device's surroundings detecting technique is mostly based on conventional sound wave location. The Blind Auditory Guidance System aims to make it simple for visually impaired people to convey their current position to their family through GPS by just pulling a trigger. A visually challenged user can effortlessly carry out and use the system's features. to create a blind communication system using sensors and RF Communication, as well as an incorrect path identification alarm system. In this study, RF Communications and ultrasonic navigation are coupled for blind users. The technology gives the blind information about his immediate surroundings so that he may walk around without running into anything. A system utilizing sensors is capable of understanding the obstacles surrounding the visually aided person up to a particular distance.

articleTitle: Perception Sensors Based Fusion System and Method for Controlling Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Taxi demand prediction has lately piqued academic attention due to its vast potential for use in expansive intelligent transportation systems. On the other hand, the majority of earlier methods merely took into account forecasting taxi demand in origin locations, omitting to simulate the particular circumstances of customers traveling to a destination. This research study presume that it is inefficient to pre-allocate taxis to each location based just on origin demand. This research study offers a significant and fascinating challenge in this work termed taxi origin-destination demand prediction, which tries to estimate future taxi demand between all area pairings. Its main challenges are figuring out how efficiently a variety of contextual data are gathered in order to understand demand trends. In this study, origin and destination views were among the classification tasks where a unique Deep Neural Network (DNN) with Deep learning-based models outperform conventional machine learning techniques. Comprehensive testing and analysis on a large dataset clearly demonstrate that, for forecasting taxi origin-destination demand, our DNN beats other evaluated approaches.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study in the Design of an ANN Based Controller
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: The power system stabilizer is based on artificial neural networks and is designed to cope with changing operational circumstances in real-world applications. The parameters of a conventional or supplementary power system stabilizer are generated with changing operating circumstances using a Multi-layer feed-forward with back propagation (MLP) Artificial neural network. As a result, the power system stabilizer's utility becomes more stable. Many researchers included this artificial neural network in their designs; however, information on network creation functions, hidden layer size, non-linear (active) functions employed in output and hidden layers, and Back Propagation (BP) training functions were not studied in detail. In this paper a study is carried out on these aspects to explore the effect of these aspects on the functionality of power system stabilizers.

articleTitle: Customer Segmentation and Market Analysis for Portfolio Generation
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: The objective behind the creation of this system is to open the gates of the world of equity market investment to all the masses. Through the utilization of data and predictive modelling, the risks that are associated with market investments can be mitigated therefore putting investors at ease and allowing them to better experiment and acclimate to the arena. This will allow a more diverse range of people to participate while also boosting the economy and shortening the barrier between those that hold a monopoly over investments in the market and those that lack the information to launch themselves into this arena and gain a foothold that would allow them to obtain financial freedom.

articleTitle: Designing of Hybrid Controllers for Improved Gain Converter for EV Application
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: The DC-DC converters play a significant role in Electric Vehicles (EVs) battery charging application. The existing DC-DC converters have generated high gain with more voltage stress in the semiconductor device and poor output voltage regulation and load changes especially for classical PI control. To rectify these issues, a hybrid controller (HC) for switch-improved gain DC-DC converter with reduced voltage stress in semiconductor is proposed. Boost converter with integration of quadratic boost converter (BCIQBO). The hybrid controller consists of a combination of Fuzzy Logic Controller (FLC) and Linear PI controllers, which are used to regulate output voltage of BCIQBC. The BCIQBC performance with HC is validated under various operating conditions such as line and load variations. The outcomes are then presented in relation to the efficiency of the designed controller for the same converter. The proposed model is better suitable for electric vehicles battery charging application. The main benefits of the proposed converter are its high gain, low switching loss, small conduction loss, low cost and small voltage stress.

articleTitle: FPGA Implementation of ECG Denoising using Kaiser Window Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: ECG aids in identifying heart diseases like coronary heart disease, arrhythmias, and heart attacks. Before making a diagnosis, the electrocardiogram (ECG) signal must be cleaned up from any artefacts that are typically present. The signal is distorted due to noises like powerline interference noise, baseline wander noise etc. To remove such noises an FIR filter has been implemented. Coefficients specific to noises have been used to design FIR filters specific to noises in ECG. While designing the filter the performance aspects of the filter have been focused upon. A kaiser window has been implemented for good balance between the noise reduction and the distortion of the ECG signal. The impulse response has a finite period in a finite impulse response filter (FIR). The multiplier block, adder block, and flip flop block are the core building blocks for the creation and application of the FIR filter. The multiplier, which is the adder's slowest block, has a significant impact on the FIR filter's performance. The use of the Booth Multiplier and carry select adder in the Finite Impulse Response Filter has been proposed. The filter and other filters have been compared for several parameters. The proposed filter is designed and implemented with Verilog and Xilinx 14.7 Vivado tools. There has been a reduction in both the area and the delay. Using this FIR filter with coefficients specific to the noises in ECG the filter for denoising ECG has been obtained. ECG signals have been taken from the MIT-BIH arrhythmia database.

articleTitle: Smart Proctoring System Using AI
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: From past two years all human activities are affected by COVID19 but where the knowledge gaining and education for students aren't stopped. Due to covid-19 affect many of the educational institutions are providing online degrees and most of the students are actively taking part in advanced online courses. Conducting online examination and proctoring all the students to stop malpractice by a single proctor is a major challenging task for educational institutions. Day by day as the technology is enlarging, with the advanced AI technology we can proctor all the students with less human effort. In this project we lively monitor the activity of test taker like Head pose estimation, object detection and voice recognition. This AI integrated system will prevent the cheating in examination without physical presence of the human proctor.

articleTitle: Computer Modeling of Agricultural Products Circulation Network with RFID Tag Sensing Algorithm
