publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: In this research study, the computer modeling of agricultural products circulation network with the RFID tag sensing algorithm is proposed. The researchers have developed a novel tag sensing algorithm that enhances the efficiency of the traditional RFID technology in the agricultural product cycle. The traditional RFID location perception method based on discrete time points cannot identify the location of the RFID tag at that moment. Hence, researchers consider the UHF RFID new tag identification model. Then, the agricultural products circulation network is selected as the application scheme, from the 2 aspects: (1) scheduling information and real-time positioning information, node information such as the node status and location are displayed; (2) when the geographic object is selected, its corresponding geographic location and attribute information are displayed. Results show that the accuracy is higher than 99% in average and the robustness is higher considering the stability.

articleTitle: Stock Market Prediction Using Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: It is challenging to anticipate stock market values, and in the past, this has necessitated significant human-computer interaction. Traditional batch processing methods cannot be effectively utilized for stock market research since stock prices are interconnected. It is practically impossible to estimate stock prices to the penny due to the unpredictability of the factors that affect price movement. However, an informed estimate of pricing is attainable. The data is provided in the form of corporate stock data, that will be evaluated in real time. The proposed system produces an output in the graphical form that depicts the predicted future stock price. Hence, this research study has proposed a solution to predict the stock market prices using the machine learning algorithm.

articleTitle: Identification of Consumer Buying Patterns using KNN in E-Commerce Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: In recent days, with the advancement of technologies, people use electronic medium to carry out their businesses. E-commerce is a process of allowing people to buy and sell products online using electronic medium. E-commerce has a wide range of customer base as well. The data generated through transaction helps the enterprises to develop the marketing strategy. The growth of this e-commerce application depends on several factors. Some of the factors are follows 1) Customer demand, 2) Analyzing buying pattern of the users, 3) Customer retention, 4) dynamic pricing etc. It is very difficult to analyze the buying pattern of customers as there is a wide range of customer base in the online platform. To overcome this problem, this research study discusses about the challenges and issues in e-commerce applications, also identifies and analyses the buying patterns of customer using various machine learning techniques. From the implementation it is identified that, KNN algorithm performed well while comparing it with various other machine learning algorithms. Performances of these algorithms have been analyzed using various matrices. For analyzing, the model is tested using e-commerce dataset (Amazon dataset downloaded from Kaggle.com). From the analysis it found that KNN algorithm computes and predicts better compared to other machine learning algorithms either Naïve Bayes, or Random Forest, or Logistic Regression etc.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Automatic Product Delivery Sorting Machine Depending on the Size
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Product sorting is a task that is used in practically every industry, including manufacturing and packing. People find it more challenging to oversee multiple processes at once as things are produced and delivered on a larger scale. This study has suggested a strategy that uses programmable logic circuits to sort the products according to their size and move them to the appropriate section to solve this problem. Three sensors and a conveyor belt serve as the design's hardware prerequisites in this study. Ladder logic is employed in the research's software to program and control every piece of hardware. Three proximity sensors are located at the start of the conveyor belt thanks to the circuit's design. Because the sensors are positioned vertically, only the lowermost sensor will detect a tiny object that is passing through the belt. The lowest sensor and the middle sensor will detect the object if it is bigger than that but not big enough to be considered the largest. Because of its size, the object is recognized by all three sensors. When a product is deemed small, a specific point where it passes triggers the pneumatic pump that is attached adjacent to the first storage box. The pump next to the second box activates when the product is classified as medium, forcing it into the medium storage box. The biggest producer also follows the same procedure. In the Mitsubishi environment, the entire circuit is set up and tested. When done so, the circuit exhibits all the precise characteristics required when the study's objectives were set. Regardless of the product type, this sorting circuit can be conveniently built and used in enterprises of all sizes.

articleTitle: Exploring Multifaceted CNN Architectures for Enhanced Detection of Multiple Sclerosis
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: The objective of this study is to augment the detection of Multiple Sclerosis (MS) through the utilization of Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architectures. MS is an autoimmune disorder that harms the myelin sheath encircling nerves, causing disruptions in the communication between the brain and body. Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is the preferred diagnostic tool for MS; however, analyzing these intricate images manually can be time-consuming. Therefore, this study employed two different CNN architectures to analyze MRI images of MS patients and healthy brains in two orientations with the aim of expediting the diagnostic process and supporting doctors worldwide. The evaluation criteria used in the study were accuracy and other relevant metrics. The findings showed that both CNN architectures successfully detected MS, but one of the architectures demonstrated superior accuracy. The performance of the models was evaluated using a set of metrics, including Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1-score, and Support. Based on the accuracy values obtained from the two models, it can be concluded that CNN has a higher accuracy compared to DenseNet169.

articleTitle: Grade Classifcation of Breast Cancer using Deep-Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Breast cancer(Bcancer) in India has a high mortality rate, with one woman dying for every two newly diagnosed. The primary reasons for this are delayed diagnosis, advanced stages of the disease upon presentation, and inadequate facilities for early detection and treatment. Bcancer does not often show early symptoms, making it difficult to prevent. Early detection can significantly improve the prognosis and survival rate by allowing for timely clinical treatment. Automating some elements of Bcancer diagnosis can increase the number of women who are screened and detected early, ultimately reducing the number of late-detected cases. By combining traditional and computer-based diagnosis methods, pathologists' workload can be reduced, and performance can be improved. Identifying and classifying subtypes of Bcancer accurately is a crucial clinical task, and automation can save time and reduce errors.further,Two models have been created for classifying histopathological images into grade I (G1), grade II(G2), and grade III(G3) BCancer. One model is designed for binary classification, while the other model is designed for multi-class classification.Despite limited computational power and a small dataset, the results are satisfactory. The models can be improved for grade-wise classification of Bcancer. Deep networks have been designed with computational tricks such as ReLU, dropout, and batch normalization to improve performance. There are several algorithms to detect breast cancer, but there is currently no grade classification for breast cancer. In this paper, our focus is on classifying the different grades of breast cancer, which will help patients understand the severity of their condition. We classify G1 as the least dangerous stage, G2 as more dangerous, and G3 as the most dangerous stage.

articleTitle: An Efficient Full Adder by Investigating XOR and XNOR Logics with PMOS and NMOS
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Investigating the XOR and XNOR logics allows for the establishment of a fast adder in the context of CMOS. The supreme aspiration of the work is to disrate the power consumption and power dissipation as well as curtailment the size of the full adder. The suggested work is intended with 10 transistors with CMOS logic and K-mapping for logic abbreviation. The system has achieved 62.77% in diminishing the power consumption, 68.134% in the crispness of the size of the full adder, and 44.11% in lessening the power dissipated. The proposed work is prosecuted in various CMOS technologies and assimilated with the conventional 10 T full adder. It is investigated that the proposed work has a sharpened performance.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Techniques for Predicting Stock Closing Prices
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Due to how unpredictable and non-linear financial markets are, it is challenging to predict stock market returns with accuracy. Programmed methods, however, have shown to be increasingly effective at forecasting stock values as artificial intelligence and processing power have advanced, This study used Support Vector Machine (SVM), Random Forest (RF), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), and Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) approaches to estimate the closing price of five businesses from distinct sectors for the following day. The models' new variables were created by using financial data, such as Open, High, Low, and Close prices, as inputs. The models were assessed using common strategic metrics, including RMSE, MSE, and MAE, where low values signify that the models were successful at predicting stock values.

articleTitle: Low-Cost Anesthesia Machine Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Anesthesia plays a substantial role in the part of pain relief during medical procedures. In general, during medical operations, the administration of anesthesia depends on the medical parameters of the cardiovascular function of the patient. In the present-day scenario, anesthetist controls the operation manually where they administer a few milliliters of anesthesia per stipulated time suitable for the requirement. Under cases where an anesthetist is unable to administer the level of anesthesia during the period of medical surgery, the patient may not undergo a successful pain-free medical surgery. In a typical anesthesia administration, two of the most important biomedical parameters are heartbeat and temperature. To solve this problem, the proposed system comprises of a micro-controlled based anesthesia device, which is methodical, and structured. The biomedical data received by the sensors is sent to the microcontroller which is a deciding factor for the amount of Anesthesia that needs to be injected periodically. In the absence of an anesthesia specialist the biomedical data can be viewed in an IOT platform “thingspeak”, throughout the medical procedure, outside of the intensive care unit. The DC motor driven by the microcontroller controls the infusion pump to administer the anesthesia levels per hour.

articleTitle: A Review on Optimization and Feature Selection Techniques for Data Security in IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Since IoT devices are becoming increasingly widespread, the security of IoT-dependent networks gets highly significant. Because of the Internet of Things' fast global proliferation, there has been a massive surge in cyber-attacks on it. Such products are connected to end-user over a public platform for flexibility of use, thereby increasing the scope of threat and endangering the confidentiality of users' data. Anyone may utilize the flaw in IoT nodes virtually anywhere that emphasizes processing resources confidentiality and safety. Optimization algorithms with the strongest feature selection approach were proposed as a potential option for minimizing different threats and to ensure data security. This paper examines and reviews Machine Learning and Evolutionary Swarm Intelligence based Optimization Algorithms with existing feature selection techniques. Further it discusses the significance of these techniques in IoT security and gives a thorough comparison of several optimization models along with the feature selection strategies used to build the models.

articleTitle: Role of Artificial Intelligence in Input Tax Credit Reconciliation
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: The Goods and Services Tax has significantly changed the economic structure of India and replaced the previous indirect taxation system. With the intention of reducing tax evasion, this new law simplifies the implementation procedure and makes tax credit technology more readily available. Prior to this time, there were several taxes, which encouraged tax evasion, increased compliance with government regulations, and burdened consumers. New statistical and analytical tools that offer speed and simplicity are now available to tax professionals. AI can help with fraud identification, which will help with governmental oversight and control. Taxes are a significant source of public finance in a growing nation like India. Taxpayers view about using artificial intelligence to power tax assessment. This study emphasizes how AI can simplify input tax credit reconciliation and future scope.

articleTitle: Lung Cancer Detection by Artificial Intelligence Using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Lung cancer is the leading cause of mortality in both men and women. However, the fatality rate can be decreased if lung cancer is detected early and treated effectively. Many countries have developed screening techniques to encourage the early diagnosis of lung cancer from Computed Tomography (CT) images, despite the fact that it is a highly challenging task for radiologists as it takes a lot of effort to manually recognize malignant lung nodules from the CT images. During the early screening phase, lung cancer is discovered; nevertheless, the clinical outcome is unpredictable. This study analyses the implementation of deep learning techniques in lung cancer detection.

articleTitle: IoT-Enabled Integrated Safety Systems for Mitigating Human Hazards in Pneumatic-Operated Buses
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: The safety of public transportation is of utmost importance to ensure the well-being of passengers and drivers. In recent years, there has been an increasing trend towards the use of pneumatic-operated buses due to their energy efficiency and low carbon footprint. However, these buses pose a significant risk to human safety in the event of an emergency such as a fire or accident. This research work proposes an IoT-enabled integrated safety system for mitigating human hazards in pneumatic-operated buses. The system utilizes temperature, smoke, and vibration sensors to detect potential emergency situations and trigger the opening of the bus door. The integration of these sensors allows for an immediate response to emergency situations, and the automatic opening of the door ensures quick and safe evacuation of passengers. The system is designed to be user-friendly and intuitive, with a simple and easy-to-understand interface for the bus driver. The sensors are placed strategically throughout the bus, ensuring maximum coverage and accuracy in detecting emergency situations. The temperature sensor detects changes in temperature within the bus, which could be an indicator of a fire. The smoke detector senses the presence of smoke, and the vibration sensor detects any sudden impacts or jolts that could indicate an accident. The proposed system has been tested using a pneumatic-operated bus in a controlled environment. The results of the testing show that the system is effective in detecting emergency situations and triggering the automatic opening of the bus door. The system can significantly reduce the risks to human safety in emergencies, providing a fast and reliable response. In conclusion, the IoT-enabled integrated safety system proposed in this research provides an innovative solution for mitigating human hazards in pneumatic-operated buses. By using temperature, smoke, and vibration sensors, the system can quickly detect emergency situations and ensure the safety of passengers and drivers by automatically opening the bus door. The proposed system has the potential to improve the safety and security of public transportation and can be implemented in pneumatic-operated buses worldwide.

articleTitle: Pain Sense: Intelligent Pain Mapping System for Spinal Cord Injuries
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Millions of people in the world suffer from the injuries and devastating ailment of spinal cord pain. For correct diagnosis and therapy, professionals must accurately identify spinal cord pain, but this can be a difficult undertaking. The machine learning method suggested in this module uses a dataset of patient medical records, imaging data, and other pertinent data to identify spinal cord pain. To extract valuable features for analysis, the data is pre-processed by utilizing signal processing and feature engineering approaches. The next step is to train a machine learning algorithm to link the retrieved features with the presence or absence of spinal cord pain using supervised learning methods like logistic regression and neural networks. The performance of the proposed algorithm is assessed by using several criteria, including accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. The research findings indicate that our method successfully detects spinal cord pain with high accuracy. This project lays the groundwork for future research in this field and shows how machine learning might improve spinal cord pain diagnosis and therapy.

articleTitle: Vehicle Theft Detection Using Neural Pattern Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Finding stolen cars is becoming increasingly important in many urban regions. An automated system for scanning license plates can recognize vehicle numbers without the need for human interaction. This work proposes a vehicle theft detection system based on neural pattern recognition, gaussian filter, and equilibrium optimization. The proposed architecture has significant speedup and higher accuracy rates. The proposed number plate recognition method has a maximum accuracy rate of 94% and an average reduction in the processing time of 32%. Pattern recognition is the process of detecting regularities and patterns in data using machine learning. These analogies may now be uncovered via statistical analysis, historical data, or machine-generated knowledge.

articleTitle: IoT Based Intelligent Pill Dispenser for Elderly People
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: In exponentially modernizing world, the growing technologies and lifestyle aids health sectors. In 2013, 13% of the world's population was 60 years of age or older, which has increased from 8% in 1950. Over the next forty years, it will grow more quickly, reaching 21% in 2050. Elderly patients with continuing loss of memory usually forget to take medicines at the right time. Treatment is considered unusable when the patient neglects to take their medication at the appropriate time as directed by their doctor. Therefore, this research presents the implementation of IoT based intelligent pill dispenser for users who should take their medicine at the proper time. The system consists of a solid prescription intelligent pill dispenser and a mobile application for configuring and monitoring it. Added features have been included to the smart medicine box such as high security, emergency alert through SMS, automatic data collection and pill details. The mobile application performs person authorization using a username and password, which is based on the Internet of Things (IoT). It monitors the parameters such as intake of medication time, pills and location details, and user and caretaker data. Additionally, the system notifies users via mobile notifications when it's time to take their medications as well as through the visuals and sounds the dispenser emits. The parameters are recorded, uploaded to the cloud and reviewed by the clinicians using the IoT system. This helps clinicians to gain knowledge about their patient's health conditions for a further treatment analysis. The feature of uploading the patient details and medical records avoids the difficulties of carrying the prescription and medical records and hence patients can live independently.

articleTitle: Advancements in Speech Recognition Technology: A Cutting-Edge Tool for Improved Speech Analysis and Interaction
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: The concept of controlling devices through voice commands has always fascinated humans, and after years of research, speech recognition systems have become widely adopted across various industries. Achieving high accuracy in voice recognition is a key focus of ongoing research, addressing factors such as background noise, linguistic and speaker diversity, vocabulary size, and domain specificity. This white paper explores the main challenges associated with developing speech recognition systems, including language classes and representations, language modeling techniques, feature extraction methods, databases, and performance evaluation. Additionally, it delineates the front-end and back-end components of the system for better comprehension and presentation. With an increasing number of people accessing the internet, a significant percentage, approximately 50% globally, face difficulties due to various impairments. These challenges go beyond data limitations and extend to actual usability issues. This paper discusses the existing problems with the website's modules, particularly in content segmentation and font accessibility for users with vision impairments. As an alternative, a continuous scrolling page format is proposed to improve information presentation and user experience.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Chatbot Haggling with Ensemble ML Model
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: In recent years online shopping has gained a huge boom. With this increase, most of the features of online shopping are developed but some features like negotiating with shopkeepers are not available which is sometimes possible in offline purchasing. In this paper we have proposed a Chatbot to conduct product negotiations. Customers can interact with the Chatbot to receive help obtaining a fair price for a product (s). With such a system, which has an impact on key aspects of online buying, there is a chance that the budget of the customer or the product seller could be compromised. To avoid such situations, we have developed an algorithm in Machine learning which works along with prediction of old available data to provide a product price. Sometimes, price prediction is less accurate because some algorithms are inappropriate for a given dataset or because irrelevant features or properties of the data are employed. Due to the potential financial losses associated with even one incorrect price prediction, Ecommerce businesses do not only rely on price prediction systems. Some models also fail when data scales or some feature is unavailable after time on which model prediction was dependent. Our model's accuracy and dependability are maintained by managing these modifications.

articleTitle: Smart Energy Monitoring Using Internet of Things: Opportunities and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Private companies and governments are working together to accelerate the implementation and progress of smart energy technical advances which can assist smart energy infrastructures. The Internet of Things (IoT) and other technology advancements enable a wide spectrum of industry operations, including distribution and transmission electricity generation, electricity production, fuel cells, system load control, and so on. The study concentrates on various IoT technology, such as sensors, connectivity, and computation innovations, as well as their regulations in connection to smart energy grids. This study also provides a thorough review of the current research on IoT applicability to the smart energy system. According to current polls and research, among the top priorities of IoT-enabled power systems is security risks associated to IoT technology. As a result, current danger and threat scenarios for IoT-enabled power facilities and present mitigating strategies for such security flaws are analysed. Last, the study discusses the support of sophisticated technology in IoT-enabled power sources and becoming more durable, secured, as well as in solving existing challenges, allowing them to grow more productive, resilient, and dependable in functioning.

articleTitle: I/O Steganography for Audio and Images in Secure Data Transmission
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: There are several uses for information concealing today. The use of data hiding knowledge may be morally or immorally acceptable. Data hiding methods, however, are difficult to classify into either the steganography or the watermarking categories because there is no clear distinction between these two concepts, and classification mostly depends on algorithmic application. Hence, regardless of how data concealing is classified, the most popular data hiding applications include copyright protection, covert communication, safe storage, and fingerprinting. Messages are altered by cryptography so they can't be understood. Secured data, varied size keys for data concealment, and quick and flexible ease of design are some of cryptography's main benefits. The biggest drawback of cryptography is that it is not suitable for the internet and is only compatible with devices like mobile phones, has complicated hardware, and uses unusual cypher patterns. Steganography is a centuries-old technique for obscuring data. In this essay, a survey of current audio steganography research is presented.

articleTitle: Optimization Strategy of Storage Layout with Video Information Based on Multi-layer Coding Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: In this research study, a mathematical model is established for the storage layout optimization problem and the related constraint problems, and the optimization scheme is solved by using the genetic algorithm introduced with the multi-layer coding strategy. In the first step, the review of the state-of-the-art genetic algorithms and the optimizations are reviewed. Then, the novel visual attention guided video image recognition algorithm is proposed to transfer the storage image to the digital scheme. Scale channel attention is used to construct the relationship between channels, assign weights to channels, and highlight more worthy objects. This will assist us to obtain the better image quality. Furthermore, the multi-layer coding genetic algorithm is proposed. The novel coding theory is applied to the traditional algorithms to reduce the time consuming of the algorithm. Lastly, the model is applied to the optimization strategy of the storage layout, the objective model is constructed with the help of the proposed algorithm. Through the testing under different iteration times, the optimal result is achieved.

articleTitle: Resisting Visual Hacking: A Novel Graphical Password Authentication System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Password-based authentication is a widely used method to ensure security and privacy in computer applications. However, the selection of weak passwords and insecure input methods by users is considered the “weakest link” in the authentication process. Instead of employing arbitrary alphanumeric sequences, individuals tend to opt for passphrases that are either mnemonic or abbreviated in nature. With the proliferation of web and mobile applications, users can access these applications at any time and from anywhere with various devices. Although this convenience is highly desirable, it also increases the likelihood of passwords being exposed to Visual Hacking. The forms of attack may be executed through either direct visual observation or the utilization of external recording devices in order to obtain the user's login information. In response to this issue, our team has devised an authentication system that centers on graphical passwords and is made to combat the threat of Visual Hacking. The system incorporates a three-layered security mechanism, comprising color and pattern matching functionalities in conjunction with password verification. This makes it highly challenging for potential attackers to deduce or limit the password even amidst numerous camera-based hacking attempts. Additionally, we have created and put to the test a prototype of the system to assess its user-friendliness. Our experimental results indicate that our system can resist Visual Hacking more effectively than previous authentication systems while still maintaining a high degree of usability and security.

articleTitle: Geriatric Fall Detection and Protection Based on IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Falls from altitudes or heights, fall on the same level from slipping or tripping, and falls from wheelchair overturns are common events that can result in severe injuries from striking the ground. An effective defense against all of these occurrences is a wearable airbag system. Motion processing methods are computed by an embedded Digital Motion Processor (DMP) based on the DMP. Using a Digital Motion Processor (DMP), We can successfully distinguish falls and other common motions. The mechanical trigger has a response time of 0.133 seconds, which allows for the release of compressed air without causing someone to fall on the ground. A prototype of the designed system is tested and the usability of the airbag system for real-time fall protection is been demonstrated.

articleTitle: Blockchain and Machine Learning Security for the Internet of Things: A Bibliometric Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: The Internet of Things has developed as a catalyst for innovation across numerous industries, from home automation to smart cities to 4IR primarily Industry 4.0. Through the internet, IoT devices interact and exchange information. Beyond its potential for development, IoT devices are divergent, ubiquitous, memory-and computational-power-constrained, making them vulnerable to a range of security and privacy risks. Blockchain, a decentralised and tamper-proof technology, has recently been introduced in the BIoT domain for securing data handling activities and inculcating trusted transactions. In anticipation of IoT System vulnerabilities, Machine Learning (ML) algorithms yield accurate findings for large and complicated databases. This study conducts a bibliometric study from the Web of Science (WoS) database from 2017 to 2022 in the area of ML-based BIoT security using Prisma guidelines. Rankings of the most productive and influential writers, articles, and sources are based on total publications and citations. Text data content analysis, Author keywords, index keywords are utilized to highlight research hotspots and future trends in the ML-Based BIoT security domain.

articleTitle: IoT based Smart Energy Consumption and Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: IOT stands for Internet of Things, is the system of computing device which has an ability to transfer data over a particular network without interfering the human to human or human to machine communication. Smart Energy Metering technology provides high resolution and frequent power consumption data which can be used to improve feedback to consumers and thus enhance power conservation and management. This research work titled IoT based smart energy consumption and monitoring system that measures voltage and frequency level in real-time and also gives a view on the development of a wireless communication technology with the use of energy meter and LoRa module. This work uses Elmeasure LG+3399 Energy Meter, RS485 convertor and LoRaWan module for study. The output is obtained in terms of voltage is demonstrated visually and the calculations have been made for the energy consumed.

articleTitle: Smart Health Card Using Mobile Application and IoT Device
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Healthcare has become extremely intelligent in the age of the internet and advanced communication. Patients who require continuous monitoring and health support outside of the hospital and in remote areas can be served by providing smart health care comparable to that available in city hospitals. In this work presents a sensible system for assessing health that reads a patient's condition using biomedical sensors and alerts the concerned party via the web. Biomedical sensors such as the heartbeat sensor, vital sign sensor, and temperature sensor are linked to the ESP32 controller, which is then interfaced with an LCD display to determine the output.

articleTitle: Half Mode Substrate Integrated Waveguide Antenna Embedded with Slots for Multiband Operations
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: The Half-mode Substrate Integrated Waveguide (HMSIW) has accumulated vast attentiveness since it was launched. This is vitally due to the afforded benefit of size reduction in contrast to a Full mode SIW and mainly to the availability of vent in the fundamental configuration. In this article, a semi-mode Substrate Integrated Waveguide (SIW) antenna is proposed for multi-band applications. This antenna is built by loading an inverted ‘L’ slot, a rectangular slot and a square slot with a small metallic incision on a rectangular SIW cavity for multiple band radiation. The introduction of slots generates a hybrid mode as a combination of TE110 and TE120 modes by coupling of these modes through metallic vias. This in turn radiate an inferior resonant frequency. The constructed half-mode SIW antenna gives in multiband response due to resonant slots and influence of microstrip inset feed thus restoring the gain and radiation characteristics of full SIW.

articleTitle: Non-Invasive Submerged Pipeline Inspection Through Advanced Image Analysis and Deep Learning Algorithms for Quantitative Deterioration Assessment
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: An identification and amount of corrosion on the pipeline which is located at bottom of the sea can be achieved by utilizing information obtained from colored corroded pipes and by estimating through the oddy test. This study proposes an algorithm for enhancing the quality of deteriorated underwater images. The algorithm aims to reduce blurring effects and improve the quality of the images, which subsequently aids in the corrosion estimation and detection process. In order to estimate the corrosion age, the oddy test is utilized, which is typically used to determine the quality of materials that are suitable for storing, transporting, or displaying museum objects. A convolution neural network is employed to categories the corrosion rate detected at corroded pipes. An images used for object detection and training the CNN are obtained from the various source which can be accessed publicly. In the defined algorithm, a result of 98% accuracy is achieved, and the algorithm is capable of estimating the approximate age of the corroded pipeline.

articleTitle: PSO Pretrained ADP Based Control Scheme for Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: The ADP-based controller is optimized using the PSO method so that it can respond appropriately to the changing dynamics of the system. The PSO-pre trained ADP-based control system is evaluated against the “Proportional-Integral (PI)” and “Fuzzy Logic Control (FLC)” strategies in terms of performance. The simulation results show that the PSO-pretrained ADP-based control scheme has the best tracking error, settling time, and steady-state error compared to the other control schemes. In terms of real-world applications, the suggested control approach may help save costs, increase efficiency, and facilitate the incorporation of renewable energy sources into existing power grids. Additional work might investigate the possibility of integrating PSO with other optimization methods to create more sophisticated and efficient control strategies for ESSs.

articleTitle: Securing Academic Meetings in the Cloud: Exploring Effective Cybersecurity Strategies
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Online virtual meetings are more accessible for everyone who needs to be there whether they join from home or any other country. For companies with a globalized work force, a good virtual meeting policy creates alignment in communication and facilitates integration between online meeting platforms. The study focuses on determining the Service quality in virtual meeting platform has an impact on client happiness. The objective is to evaluate if the online platform was adequate in comparison to the group's earlier in-person meetings held and to offer suggestions for enhancements to next online group sessions. Enhancements to online virtual meeting places are necessary to retain trust as digital meetings become the new norm. Teams that focused on more functional interactions, such as problem-solving and action planning, were much happier with their meetings. Sending notifications and alarms before a meeting begins by 10 minutes is the primary objective of the project. The complete participant database is also something that can be stored.

articleTitle: Electricity Demand Forecasting Using ML
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: There is lot of uncertainties on demand of electricity in the global market. Building a model to predict the future electricity demand would be very useful. There are various factors which are needed to be considered for the prediction of the demand, some of them are climate, socioeconomic activities, population etc. In the model we are going to see different forecasting methods used for predicting the demand. In the model we are doing comparative and testing analysis between different parameters. We try to reduce the error percentage to get an accurate reading. We have used linear regression and mean absolute error methods to solve the problem. Linear Regression is used to predict the value of a variable using another variable. Linear and Logistic are most widely used regression techniques. The projection of a societies long term power demand helps us to determine how much capacity is needed for the future demand. Such methods are very helpful in electrical compositions in the power generation like nuclear plants, hydro plant, etc. Similar to energy demand evaluation, electricity supply analysis is vital to determine the feasibility of an strength challenge. This forecast needs to be based on our historic records, consisting of evaluations of beyond tendencies and the present power deliver, studies of the electricity technology, transmission and distribution systems, of the available assets for energy technology and of existing and deliberate interconnections to neighboring structures.

articleTitle: FMCG Market Analysis for Wholesalers and Retailers Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: The fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) industry is one of the largest and most dynamic industries globally, comprising a vast range of products that are sold fast and at relatively low cost. FMCG products are typically purchased frequently and in large quantities by consumers, making it an essential market for both retailers and wholesalers. To understand the FMCG market trends and consumer behavior, machine learning techniques and statistical analysis were utilized, including the use of Python libraries such as Pandas, Seaborn, Matplotlib, and Mlxtend. The methodology adopted involved data collection, data preprocessing, and data analysis using various machine learning algorithms. The data collection process involved gathering information from different sources, including online databases, market research reports, and surveys. After gathering the data, it was pre-processed to ensure data precision, reliability, and thoroughness. The processed data was then examined using various machine learning algorithms, such as linear regression, decision trees, and random forests. FMCG market analysis is highly significant due to its capacity to evaluate large and complicated datasets, detect trends, and predict future developments. Moreover, the literature survey highlighted the significance of FMCG market analysis in identifying consumer behavior and predicting market trends, which is vital for retailers and wholesalers to make knowledgeable choices. The outcomes achieved from the examination suggest that machine learning strategies can accurately anticipate FMCG market trends, cus-tomer behavior, and sales patterns. The analysis also revealed that product excellence, cost, and promotions significantly impact customer purchasing behavior in the FMCG sector

articleTitle: Characteristic Analysis of Power Grid Disaster Early Warning Signal: A Case Study
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: This research study completes the construction of a disaster monitoring and early warning system for smart grids, based on the actual needs of disaster prevention and planning work, in order to effectively compensate for the deficiencies in the existing grid disaster prevention, mitigation and relief work. Through the review, it was noticed that in terms of early warning analysis of natural disasters in power grids, there is currently a lack of application of dynamic early warning analysis based on the evolution of disaster, and to deal with this, several innovation ideas are proposed, such as: (1) The different disaster types are defined and their connection patterns are re-defined to better estimate the risk level. (2) The comprehensive non-stop rate of regional transmission lines and its fuzzification are defined to better estimate the status. (3) Linear matrix inequalities are applied to provide an accurate estimate of the stability. The warning performance is validated by the experiment with the public data set and the efficiency of the warning performance has been proven.

articleTitle: Morphology Extraction and Analysis of Calligraphy Fonts Images: A Novel Perspective
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: With the development of the computers, people's demand for image processing technology is increasing day by day, and many new algorithms have been created, further promoting the development of the field of image processing. Among them, morphological processing of color images plays an important role. In this research study, it is proposed the novel perspectives on the morphology extraction and analysis of calligraphy fonts images. In the classical morphological image processing, the structured information reflected by the pixel values in the image is not considered, to deal with this, the proposed model has 3 focuses: (1) image invariant moments as initial processing is used to serve as the basic step of processing the information. The Krawtchouk moment and Tchebichef orthogonal scale polynomial model are combined to make the algorithm efficient; (2) color morphology extraction and analysis of images is conducted as well as keeping the structural information; (3) novel neural network model is proposed to extract the features. Through the experiment, it can be seen that the proposed model can effectively obtain the image features.

articleTitle: A Tour of a Technical and Educational Campus Using Virtual Reality
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Today, in this technical world, where all subjects are changing from traditional approach to digital approach, extended reality (ER) has played an important role in supporting this change. One of the efficient parts of ER is virtual reality (VR). VR can be defined as bringing a virtual world or fictitious world into real life where a user can explore the world in his/her own home space without any interference. VR can be well applied in various fields such as education like viewing solar space in school using VRHeadset in immersive way so that students can understand the concept clearly, construction and industrial regions like designing the building in virtual space before starting the actual development process so that the engineer have proper idea for development without much loss, simulations including training regions, gaming industries for entertainment, tourism, virtual tour, etc. Considering virtual tour as one of the test cases of VR, creating a virtual tour of St. John College of Engineering and Management (SJCEM) campus would be much preferable for visitors so that students can not only get an immersive experience of the campus but also can explore different sections of the campus without any interruptions using VR at their own home space. This study aims to provide a virtual tour of SJCEM campus to a user whose can not only explore the campus but also take an in and out immersive experience.

Author Keywords: St. John College of Engineering and Management (SJCEM) campus

articleTitle: Impulsive Noise Mitigation for Power Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: This research study intends to reduce the impulsive noise for power communication, for this, a circuit has been designed. This circuit uses sine wave generator FIR filter, LMS filter, and telescope. When applied the input signal to the scope, FIR filter, and LMF filter. By using a sine wave generator generate a sine wave.FIR filter reduces the noise in the input signal. An input signal is also applied to the LMF filter. This LMF filter compares the applied input signal and desired signal, and this LMF filter output is applied to the adder. The output of the discrete signal and FIR filter output is added by using the adder. Therefore there are four inputs applied to the scope. Through this scope, we can see the mitigation output noise through the scope.

articleTitle: Battery Health Prediction Using Deep Hybrid Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: The type and condition of the road the vehicle travels; how long the battery is used for are just a few of the variables that affect the battery life of electric cars (EVs). These elements might affect the battery's lifespan by causing it to drain more quickly than usual. By understanding the various factors that impact battery life, work can be done to mitigate these issues and extend the useful life of the battery. To find the best circumstances for increasing the battery's longevity, this research paper is concentrated on examining the impacts of road conditions on battery life. The previous article classified routes with an accuracy of 83.56% based on battery health while arriving at the destination [1]. This article examines EV routed and categorises them on the basis of the number of brakes applied upon arrival at the destination. By doing so, it aims to develop recommendations for drivers on how to optimize their driving habits to extend the battery's lifespan. Observations indicate that bad routes generally involve a lot more brakes as compared to good routes. Vehicle speed has a negative correlation with heater power in a bad route and a positive correlation in a good route. Battery voltage and Battery state- of-charge have opposing correlations in both categories. In this research, a prediction of the route category was attempted by using Deep Hybrid Learning to integrate three pre-trained models., VGGI6, Resnet50 and VGG19 with two boosting algorithms:- XGBoost and AdaBoost. The accuracy of the six deep hybrid learning models in predicting the category of these routes are as follows:-0.87625, 0.84875, 0.80125, 0.7925, 0.8425 and 0.855.

articleTitle: Assessment of the Environmental Impact of Solar Energy Systems in Urban Areas
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: The main goal of this research study is to compare and analyze how four different cities with three different solar systems affect the environment. This study has analyzed how much water each method used, how much carbon it made, and how it affected the amount of land that could be used. Based on what we've found, the effects of these systems on the environment are very different. Across all four groups, Type C systems have the biggest effect on the environment. These results have important implications for leaders, urban planners, and people who want to see more safe energy growth in cities. By figuring out how different solar energy systems affect the environment, our study helps guide the making of rules and laws that support sustainable energy practices. For a healthy future, it is important for people and groups to understand how solar energy sources affect the world. The economic and social factors that affect the use of solar energy systems in cities should be looked into, and the effects of different types of solar energy systems on the environment should be considered in the future.

articleTitle: Predicting Stock Prices with Machine Learning and Virtual Stock Market Game
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: This research study has proposed a cutting-edge stock trading simulator that allows users to experience the thrill of investing in the stock market using virtual currency. With an intuitive interface, users can easily learn how to buy and sell stocks, manage their portfolio, and make informed investment decisions in a risk-free environment. The virtual currency system ensures that users can practice and hone their trading skills without risking real money. The simulator also provides users with real-time market data, educational resources, and tools to help them achieve their investment goals. The main aim of this research study is to gamify and induce collaboration with friends in a dedicated room and check their relative competence. Users can make use of prediction models for investing purposes which have been trained using the LSTM algorithm. It has been thoroughly tested using various prediction algorithms like LSTM algorithm, Gradient Boosting regression, Random Forest Regression etc. After comparison, LSTM outperformed other algorithms and proved to be efficient for stock price predictions.

articleTitle: EEG Signal Classification and Analysis for Upper Limbs Using SVM and Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: People with motor disabilities will be facing difficulties to interact with the environment with the support of their (PNS) peripheral nervous system. Brain–computer interface (BCI) systems use activity of the brain's cortex to control prosthetic devices like robotic arm which would be highly helpful in passing information to them EEG can be utilized to detect activations of the human brain indicating the motor activity and it is an upcoming idea in the field of BCI. This idea aims at developing a system that records the motor execution signals during the right- and left-arm & hand movements from 7 channels placed on frontal lobes. The alpha and beta signals are of interest because they correspond to the voluntary motor movements. Our work aims at acquiring EEG signals, pre-processing to denoise and only the signals from the channels of interest were extracted. Along with features like mean, minimum, maximum, two other features - log energy entropy and Katz fractal dimension are investigated and their effects on the classifiers SVM and Random Forest were studied. The classifiers' performance is analysed when all 7 channels out of 21 are considered. Classification of EEG signals corresponding to motor execution tasks gave accuracy value of (93 ± 2%)% along with F1- score of 0.98 for Random Forest and accuracy (89±5)% and F1- score of 0.89 for SVM over 7 channels of frontal lobe EEG, Proving that Random forest classifier can be utilized for classification of EEG signals.

articleTitle: Implementation of the Tapered Fiber Sensor, for Measuring Failures Induced by Vibration in Rotary Electric Motors Using the ANSYS Simulator
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: In this work, a sensor based on Narrowed Optical Fibers (NOF) or Taper, as it is also known, is developed, which allows the measurement of vibrations in electric motors using the cantilever or cantilever bar mechanical model. The objective of this study is to characterize the tapered fiber sensor, based on the vibration measurement range, to accurately measure vibration-induced faults in rotary electric motors. For this, a theoretical study of the mechanical system used is carried out, and then the behavior of the structure is modeled using the ANSYS simulator to determine the frequency values that can be measured with the sensor. Then a practical assembly of the measurement system is developed where a LASER at 1310 nm, an InGasAs 675RE Rifocs photodetector, an ISOTRON model 256–100 commercial accelerometer is used as a light source, for the characterization in frequencies and obtaining the frequency nature of the model. Finally, the system is coupled to electric motors to which vibration faults are introduced that are detected by the developed system.

articleTitle: Intelligent Fire Detection and Alert System with Sensing Capabilities Powered by Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has become a popular tool to perform video surveillance in order to detect and identify humans, vehicles, objects, and events. By analyzing audio and images via computer software programs, AI model can identify people's faces and other emerging technologies that are commonly used in security monitoring systems. The main purpose of this study is to explore the different areas, where Artificial Intelligence (AI) can be used to detect and prevent fires.

articleTitle: Virtual Visit to Pilgrimages Using Augmented Reality
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Augmented reality is an immersive experience which combines both real-world and computer-generated content. The AR in the tourism sector is quite popular these days. The use of augmented reality in the tourism industry can improve the travel experience, provide useful information to travelers, and aid in the promotion of tourist sites and destinations. The aim of this study is to develop web application using AR/VR that interacts with the actual environment and aids in increasing tourism. This web-based application can be used to digitally travel to Indian pilgrimage sites for those who are unable to leave their homes but are interested in spiritual journeys. HTML5 and JavaScript are utilized to create non-installing and easy to use web-based application. This web application will connect 360-degree visuals of pilgrimages so that users can see a location from all angles. It will also give site-specific information and directions to the location. This research focuses on promoting India's culture and the grandeur of its monuments.

articleTitle: Internet of Things Towards the Implementation of a Smart City
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: The concept of a “Smart City” is often cited as an example of one of the Internet of Things (IoT) applications that is both fascinating and significant. If metropolitan areas want to keep their relevance in the 21st century, they will need to become more intelligent, smart, and connected. The Internet of Things helps speed up the development of some of the world's most impressive urban areas. In recent years, a variety of concepts for the implementation of smart cities have been proposed, but the one that is now under consideration makes use of a smart phone as its graphical user interface (GUI). There is no need for extra equipment on the part of the user since almost everyone in this day and age of digital technology already has a smartphone. This research study recommends three modules: intelligent highway management, intelligent parking management, and intelligent garbage management. As more research studies have been conducted on the smart parking paradigm, the recommended model is more advanced because it employs the camera on a mobile phone to detect whether or not a parking spot is vacant. This is because there have been more research studies on the smart parking paradigm.

articleTitle: Wind Energy Into Power Using VAWT
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: The need for energy in daily life is rapidly increasing. As a result, increasing the rate of production is critical. However, the majority of the resources utilized are traditional energy sources, which have a finite supply and reduce with time. As a result, finding a new way to bridging the power gap is critical. The best way to mitigate the challenge in this case is to employ renewable energy sources. Wind energy is the most accessible and sustainable energy source. Due to the high volume of traffic, the highway produces a significant and practically continuous source of wind energy. Electricity can be generated from wind turbine.

articleTitle: Structural Health Monitoring Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Environmental factors, particularly vibrations and temperature can damage the structural health of the building. To avoid heavy damage to the building and to maintain the building's structural health this paper suggests monitoring of building using machine learning algorithms. Machine learning algorithms are used to predict temperature and vibration damages in buildings. Temperature and vibration values are obtained through the grove vibration sensor and NTC thermistor attached to Raspberry Pi 3B plus. In the Raspberry pi, Machine learning algorithms are executed. The activation functions used are Relu, Sigmoid, and Tanh. The experimental results reveal that the Sigmoid activation function gives the best results in terms of metrics with accuracy 94.25, Precision 0.951, Recall 0.912, and F1 score 0.388. The sigmoid function is used in machine learning algorithms for predicting temperature and vibrations. Predicted temperature and vibrations damages are sent to the server and viewed through the user mobile. K- Nearest Neighbor algorithm produced best results with an accuracy rate of 85.50, Precision of 0.922, Sensitivity of 0.830, Specificity of 0.840 and F1 score of 0.873.

articleTitle: Integrating AI and Computer Vision for Effective Foreign Object Detection on Airport Runways
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: The FOD-R Dataset is a collection of images that depict common types of foreign object debris (FOD) that can be found on runways or taxiways. The dataset has primarily been annotated using bounding boxes to facilitate object detection. However, the FOD-xR Dataset includes an additional feature - color codes - that provide information on the ease of removing the debris. Lightweight objects are marked in green, while heavy objects are marked in red. This centralized system simplifies coordination efforts, making it easier for organizations to manage FOD removal effectively. This, in turn, can have a positive impact on an organization's bottom line by minimizing delays and damage caused by FOD incidents. Overall, the FOD-R and FOD-xR Datasets are valuable resources for organizations looking to improve their FOD detection and removal processes.

articleTitle: Fingerprint Recognition Using SVM and CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Among other things, fingerprints are frequently used to open automobiles and residences, authorise payments, and unlock devices. Due to its accessibility, dependability, acceptability, and high level of security, digital fingerprinting has emerged as a popular biometric identification method. Unfortunately, a number of issues, including finger displacement during scanning, outside circumstances, and user behavior, have reduced the accuracy of fingerprint identification. SVM, CNN, image processing, image extraction, binarization, and thinning algorithms have all been used to address these issues. These methods reduce the misuse of fingerprint samples while providing creative solutions to fingerprint identification issues. Machine learning has been particularly beneficial in documenting student attendance in college residence halls, identifying victims at crime scenes, and accurately extracting images. Overall, it is a quick, dependable, accessible, and affordable approach to give everyone easy access.

articleTitle: Road Maintenance System using YOLOV7
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Road transport is one of the most important types of transportation; it plays an important part in a country's economic growth by connecting communities and businesses, as well as giving access to education, job, social, and health services. Many factors, including weather, significant traffic volumes, large numbers of heavy vehicles, shoddy building methods and materials, and poor road maintenance, can cause damage to roads. Potholes are the most bothersome road damage/defect, causing discomfort to travelers, car damage, and accidents. Even if there aren't many big trucks in the traffic stream, their influence is noticeable. Due to their physical qualities of length, size, and acceleration/deceleration, heavy trucks have an adverse physical and psychological impact on the flow of nearby traffic. Potholes are frequently associated with accidents, and such data analysis from a basic set of variables to a broader set of variables will be beneficial to the Mumbai public in a variety of ways. This paper aims to limit the occurrence of potholes by tracking the number of vehicles plying over a certain road, classifying the vehicles into light transport vehicles and heavy transport vehicles and estimating the amount of load being borne by the road due to the heavy transport vehicles. Potholes are detected using YoloV7and then generalized to the entire city using an Android app and Google Maps.

articleTitle: Enhancing Pool Safety and Efficiency with an IoT Supported Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Drowning, which occurs regularly in a watery setting, is a severe public health risk, particularly for all age groups. According to World Health Organization figures, drowning kills approximately 3,60,000 individuals annually. Drowning is still one of the leading causes of death in both children and adults. Most people do not have a proper skill to swim in water bodies. A large number of people died as a result of poor swimming skills. As a result, Hydro Stagnation Rescue System is created that monitors and updates the status of swimmers with the support of IoT. This device also monitors several parameters in the swimming pool and notifies the maintenance staff if there are any deviations from the observed values.

articleTitle: Covid-19 Classification Model Based on Age and Gender Analysis Using SWHO-Based Deep CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Nowadays, Corona Virus Disease-19 (COVID-19) disease is considered one of the main health issues, which is spreading in the worldwide environment, and due to this, infected patients are isolated to avoid spreading the disease. So, instant recognition is required for classifying the disease in a precise manner. Hence, the SWHO deep convolutional neural network (CNN) classification is developed to analyze the disease and the process of rising the COVID-19 classification scheme commences with collecting the blood samples and proceeds through preprocessing, feature extraction, as well as classification. Thus, the accuracy, sensitivity, as well as specificity of the developed method attained the value of 89.797%, 92.351%, and 88.252%, at 80% of training.

articleTitle: Development of PLC Based Level Control System for Conical Tank System for Water Treatment Plant
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: The controller's primary responsibility in the process industry is eliminating numerous disruptions and maintaining stability. Like any process tank, the shape is crucial in the design of regulators. To lessen land and water pollution, wastewater treatment facilities are becoming increasingly common in many industrial and organizational sectors. Conical tanks are crucial components of sewage treatment facilities. In wastewater applications where the tank must be empty, cone bottom tanks are utilized to stop sludge from the tank from getting into the subsequent operations. Conical tanks are used in the process sector because it is simple to empty their contents. Controlling the level of liquid is an essential responsibility in many operations. In this research, the liquid level is managed in a conical tank system without interactions. Level control is incredibly challenging for conical tanks because of their non-linear features and wide range of size and diameter. Current methodologies incorporate Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) controllers in their control systems. 90% of automated controllers used in the process sector are PID controllers, the foundation for many sophisticated control algorithms and techniques. PID controllers are the industry standard for feedback control, and are commonly used in linear systems because of their simplicity, versatility, and effectiveness. However, the presence of non-linearities in the process can limit their applicability. This study describes the maintaining process levels at specified operating conditions and achieving optimal performance using a fuzzy-tuned PID controller.

articleTitle: IoT And GSM Applications for Industrial Health Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: In recent years, IoT and wireless technology have mostly dominated the industrial sector, especially since the demand to support numerous industries has increased. Recently, a lot of unexpected incidents have occurred in a variety of businesses. As a result, security is now a major concern for everyone. In the current research study, a novel intelligent smart security system for the industrial sector based on various wireless sensors, NodeMCU microcontroller with IoT network, and GSM module is proposed. This invention, the Industrial Protection System, uses IoT and GSM to detect any chemical spills or leaks, gas leaks, fires or boiler explosions, short circuits, and temperature and humidity readings from a variety of smart sensors. As a result, it is capable of measuring any environmental variation, keeping track of the most recent industry conditions, and alerting the proprietor by SMS via the internet. Knowing the situation allows for the right course of action that will safeguard industry from accidents and save several lives. Any computer, mobile device, or other smart device can be used to monitor it from anywhere at any time. The work's major accomplishment is the merging of embedded electronics and computer programming. The fact that this device is portable and can connect to both a computer and a mobile device over the internet is one of its additional benefits.

Author Keywords: GSM module (Global system for Mobile network)

articleTitle: UVM Based Design Verification with Semi-Automation
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: This paper uses Python's Openpyxl and Tkinter libraries to build a verification testbench based on the Universal Verification Methodology (UVM) for the Advanced Peripheral Bus (APB) architecture. The GUI is created using Python. For validation purpose testbench is also written using Questasim software. The Python-created template is compared with the Questasim software created testbench. The APB interface is used in numerous system-on-chip (SoC) designs, so its verification is crucial. An automated testbench built with Python can reduce the time required for designing testbench.

articleTitle: Detection and Classification of Lung Tumors using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Several medical fields have been using image processing techniques in recent years to improve diagnosis and treatment in the early stages. It is particularly important to diagnose a patient's illness as soon as possible when the patient has multiple tumors, such as breast and lung cancers. As part of this procedure, the lungs are divided into segments and inspected individually for nodules in order to determine the disease's extent. Since CT lung tumors are known to have a variety of shapes and hazy tumor boundaries, stimulated tumor segmentation is always appealing, even though various lung tumor segments have been documented. Using high-resolution microtomography (micro-CT), it has been demonstrated that lung tumors can be detected both early and late in the formation process in living mice. The prevalence of adenocarcinoma and squamous cell lung cancer in all lung tumors is thought to be 30%• In this innovative concept, the usefulness of 2D and 3D imaging features for tumor classification is examined. For tumor classification models, wrapper and Relief-F feature selection strategies were combined with decision trees and support vector machines. The accuracy of 2D elements is almost as good as 3D elements, although 3D elements are easy to use. Visual inspection of postmortem inflated and removed lungs further validated the micro-CT results. Micro-CT technology offers a wide range of possibilities for non-invasive imaging of tumor development and progression. Micro-CT technology allows continuous lung cancer treatment research to take place.

articleTitle: Optimal Service Reconfiguration and Restoration of Network using Cuckoo - Search and Prim's Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: This study proposes a hybrid technique for solving the problem of optimal service reconfiguration and restoration of distribution network with Cuckoo-Search algorithm and Prim's algorithm. Network reconfiguration problem is done to minimize the losses in the network during varying load conditions. Service Restoration is an application of reconfiguration problems done during line outage conditions in the distribution network. Network reconfiguration problem are difficult to solve, because of two criteria. The first criteria is to identify the switching sequence as there are large number of sectionalizing and tie switches involved, since for ‘m’ switches in the network, the combinations will be of the order of 2m, and the second is to satisfy the radial conditions. Therefore, this research work applied Cuckoo-Search technique and Prim's algorithm to find the desirable switching sequence thereby reducing the search space for a particular load condition of the network. In this Cuckoo-search algorithm is used to generate various switching sequence and the Prim's algorithm is utilized to check the radial condition. The MATLAB simulation of Cuckoo-Search and Prim's algorithm is implemented in a 33 - bus IEEE test distribution network. The results show that not only the loss reduction but also voltage improvement during the distribution networks service reconfiguration and restoration.

articleTitle: Microcontroller Based Automatic Saree Folding Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Today's population follows a strict routine in their everyday lives. Despite gender inequality, household chorus has been a hardship for many. The section of the chorus that is concerned with laundry is among the ones that takes the most time and effort. Depending on the amount of clothing and the number of people living in a home, this task may be challenging and even stressful for some people. An automatic, motor-driven saree folding machine is called the Easy Saree Folding Machine. The project's goal is to fold a saree by simply pressing a button. The saree must be placed on the folding tray of the fully automatic machine before pressing the button. The saree will then fold by itself. To regulate the motion of the folding component in this system, four stepper motors are used. Typically, a person folds their garments using the traditional manner, which involves hand folding. There are numerous issues that working women typically have while trying to manage their time for household duties. This project aims to present a simple, fully automatic saree folding device. In the suggested system, a Wiper motor rotates and regulates the folding motion in accordance with a microcontroller program. The folding process' entire motion is managed by the microcontroller. According to the results obtained, the proposed method can significantly minimize the amount of time spent to manually fold the clothes.

articleTitle: Design of Internet of Things Based Remote Infusion Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Intravenous infusion therapy plays a crucial role in saving people's lives. Current infusion pump system requires a huge manpower for monitoring. So, this proposed system incorporates Internet of Things (IoT) for remote monitoring which gives a better physician to patient ratio. The system employs a Node Microcontroller Unit (MCU) ESP8266 microcontroller for monitoring the weight of Intravenous (IV) bottle using load cell. A customized 3d printed pressure clamp using servo motor is designed for automatic valve closure. This system notifies its user and the care taker when the fluid in the bottle goes below a predefined threshold value and the servo motor closes the valve when empty bottle condition is detected. The data are transmitted over the air using Wi- Fi module. Blynk mobile app is used to display the parameters and also gives access to caregivers for controlling the system parameters in real time wirelessly. The system is tested with different case scenario and the accuracy is 99%. Thus, this system simplifies the process of IV fluid administration and reduce manpower to a great extent.

articleTitle: Survey on Smart Helmet Based on IoT for Detection of Road Accidents
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Accidents occur more frequently now than ever before. With the increased use of bikes and motorbikes, an alarming number of traffic accidents has been reported in several nations each year. Even though the government implements enough laws and regulations to prevent road accidents, the accident rate continues to rise. Reasons such as not wearing a helmet when riding a bike and riding while inebriated are worth mentioning. Motorcycle riders cause significant traffic accidents that result in fatalities when not wearing helmets and riding bikes while inebriated. This research, a very practical and sophisticated.
