publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: This research article presents the design and development of a 6-axis robot for enhancing assembly line safety in automotive manufacturing. The robot is designed to automate car assembly operations, eliminating the need for human labor and enhancing workplace safety. The robot's six axes of motion allow for increased flexibility and precision, enabling it to perform complex assembly tasks accurately and efficiently. The development process of the 6-axis robot involved various stages, including conceptualization, design, prototyping, testing, and optimization. The robot's design is based on a modular architecture, which allows for easy customization and integration into existing assembly line systems. The robot's performance was evaluated through various experiments, including cycle time, accuracy, repeatability, and safety. The results show that the 6-axis robot is capable of performing assembly tasks with high accuracy and repeatability, reducing cycle time and increasing productivity. Furthermore, the robot's safety features, such as collision avoidance and emergency stop, ensure safe operation, minimizing the risk of accidents and injuries. The proposed 6-axis robot provides an effective solution for enhancing assembly line safety in automotive manufacturing. Its automation capabilities can help reduce the need for human labor, minimize workplace hazards, and improve productivity. The modular design of the robot allows for easy customization, making it suitable for various assembly line systems.

articleTitle: Performance Improvement of Sliding Mode Controller of BLDC Drive for EV Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: BLDC motors are becoming popular in low and medium power drive applications, position control, and also servo applications. Because of its very smooth speed control within a specified limit, high efficiency, and low maintenance cost, this motor is widely accepted for wide range of applications. The motor has excellent linear speed torque characteristics for an electromechanical actuator. It is possible to achieve a good speed response from the machine using simple control theory. The various control principles used in BLDC motor drives to control the speed and currents, necessitate extremely complex calculations, so DSP controllers must be incorporated. This will significantly increase the system's cost. In this study, a simple but cost-effective solution for improving the performance of a BLDC motor is proposed. The scheme employs a digital on-off or hysteresis band controller that is based on simple logic. This study also includes hardware implementation, which is based on a low - cost microcontroller.

articleTitle: Protocol-based Security Mechanism for Satellite Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: A completely linked world with sixth generation (6G) networks is anticipated as a result of the convergence of terrestrial radio and satellite communications. Satellite physical restrictions on the amount of available power and space results in low computing power, constrained storage capacity, and compromised security. Data may therefore be susceptible to modification and contamination by others. Security concerns have arisen as satellite communications have become increasingly important to international communications networks. In satellite networks, it can be difficult to efficiently use storage and secure information access. With regard to satellite communication networks, this proposal suggests a privacy and authentication system based on QKD protocol. This is accomplished by implementing a wireless, heterogeneous network connectivity architecture that combines both open-source and commercially available devices. Registration, authentication, and revocation are the three processes that enable communication. Satellites transmit the gathered data to ground stations, which then record all significant parameters on the system's decentralized blockchain. All certificates from malicious nodes are removed from the blockchain by ground stations. It has been suggested for use with 6G networks in the future and beyond the Internet of Things, self-driving cars, and other quickly developing applications. Excellent security levels are provided by satellite-based blockchain and QKD systems.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of IoT Based Fire Suppression System for the Safety of Industry 4.0
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: The advent of Industry 4.0 has brought about a revolution in the manufacturing sector, making it smarter and more efficient than ever before. However, with this increased automation, the risk of fire has also increased, making it imperative to have a fire suppression system in place. In this research, a novel IoT-based fire suppression system is proposed to tackle this issue. The system consists of various sensors such as flame sensors, smoke sensors, humidity sensors, and temperature sensors that are strategically placed in the factory. These sensors detect the presence of fire and trigger a series of actions, including activating a buzzer alarm, spraying a fire-extinguishing fog, and opening gates to help put out the fire. The system is designed to be highly efficient and effective in suppressing fires, making the industry safer for everyone. The system is also flexible, allowing it to be easily customized to suit the specific requirements of each factory. The use of IoT technology in the system makes it possible to monitor the fire suppression system remotely, allowing the factory owner to have real-time information on the status of the system. This information can be used to quickly respond to any issues that arise, ensuring the safety of the factory at all times. The research conducted in this area has the potential to greatly improve the safety of the manufacturing sector, making it a crucial step towards the future of Industry 4.0.

articleTitle: Efficient Beamforming Techniques in MU-MIMO
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Multiple Input Multiple Output (MIMO) communications is one of the main delved technologies in 5G. MIMO systems fused with beamforming antenna array technologies are anticipated to play a crucial part in coming generations of wireless communication systems. Beamforming is a technique in which it focuses wireless signals into a particular direction where the receiving device is present, rather than spreading the signal in all directions. Beamforming is used in tandem with MIMO to concentrate the ray on an individual user which enables advanced connection densities and minimizing interference. Adaptive beamforming is the beamforming technique in which the optimum weights are iteratively computed using complex algorithms grounded upon different criteria. This paper presents an analysis of distinct types of adaptive beamforming ways and opting the most effective algorithm which can be stationed in MIMO systems and propose an effective model to perform beamforming.

articleTitle: Verifcation of Academic Records Using Hyperledger Fabric and IPFS
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Document forgery has become a significant concern recently due to the rapid development of modern technology and the simplicity of obtaining inexpensive, cutting-edge workplace supplies. Numerous cases of academic certificate fraud have been documented due to the lack of an effective anti-forgery system. Due to the lack of an effective anti-forgery system, incidents that result in the academic certificate being faked are frequently observed. As a result, methods for educational credential verification and authentication are becoming more and more necessary. Blockchain technology offers a promising solution for creating a secure, transparent, and immutable system for storing and verifying academic records. This paper proposes a permissioned blockchain-based system for verifying academic records using Hyperledger Fabric and InterPlanetary File System(IPFS). Hyperledger Fabric is a distributed ledger platform that supports smart contracts and private transactions among authorized participants. IPFS is a peer-to-peer file system that enables decentralized data storage and retrieval. The system allows academic institutions to issue digital certificates to their graduates and store them on IPFS. The hash of the certificates is then recorded on the Hyperledger Fabric blockchain. When a process is started to check if an academic certificate is real, the credentials are pulled from the off-chain database, and their hashes are generated. This hash is then compared to a hash that is already on the Blockchain. The suggested model completely satisfies all digital document verification system requirements by addressing the shortcomings and challenges in the current document verification methods.

articleTitle: Design of Sensor Assisted Lake Water Cleaning Robot Using Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Water is the basic natural source of each and every individual. Nowadays a lot of pollution is found in the environment due to human waste, especially plastic waste. In this research work, a novel robotic structure is designed to collect the waste materials specifically plastic wastes from the water and provides a clean water surface. For this scheme, a boat-like structure is designed with intelligent sensors and DC motors to do the waste collection operation in an intelligent manner. A solar PV oriented battery-operated boat robot is planned to collect the waste materials from the lake water, in which the structure of the robot is efficient enough to run over the lake and accumulate plastics and put them up into the container. The purpose of this portable garbage collector robot is to encourage people to learn about and keep an eye on the condition of the lakes. Small lakes, narrow rivers, land, and drains are what the trash collector was made to clean up. The robot's movement is managed by a mobile application using Internet of Things connectivity. The effectiveness of the garbage collector's control system and its capacity for collecting waste were both put to the test. Using data gathered from tests conducted in a pool, user understands that it can travel great distances and collect lightweight recyclables like food containers, drink bottles, and plastics. Within the bounds of the available network, this apparatus is controlled to float and travel down the river. This water garbage collector uses an ultrasonic sensor to monitor the waste bin's contents; therefore, it's best to make it out of a durable yet lightweight material. The proposed Internet of Things (IoT) support is achieved by using the controller called ESP32, which provides clear network assistance to the mobile garbage collecting robot to information regarding the number of wastes collected into the dustbin as well as the respective period of collection and so on. The proposed lake water cleaning method effectively helps nature preserve the dignity of the lakes while also collecting 95% of floating trash.

articleTitle: Identification of Sickle Cell Anemia by Employing Hybrid Optimization and Recurrent Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Red blood cell deficiencies are the root cause for anaemia. In sickle cell anaemia, the red blood cell's (RBCs) shape shifts into a crescent or sickle form. It takes a lot of time and effort to manually examine tiny images. Red blood cells have complicated and varied forms, and their overlapping cells make categorization and counting of them difficult. In this study, sickle cell identification in microscopic images is automated. The RBCs are then classified into three forms: round, elongated (sickle cell), and other shapes using image processing and deep learning approaches. Sickle cell illness fatalities can be decreased and the condition may be managed successfully with early discovery. In order to identify sickle cell disease, hybrid optimization, and recurrent neural networks have been developed. This technique first gathers images of blood cells. The image is enhanced by using the wiener filter during the initial processing step. Images of red blood cells are then segmented using Otsu thresholding. The hybrid whale and particle swarm optimization (WPSO) technique is used for extracting the characteristics from images. In order to categorize the RBC cells, a recurrent neural network (RNN) classifier is utilized. A variety of factors, including precision, accuracy, recall, and f1-score, are used to evaluate the efficiency of the suggested approach. The results of the research have been compared with other methods now in use. In comparison to current techniques, the suggested approach offered more accuracy and precision. Saving people's priceless lives would be made possible by this automated detection method.

Author Keywords: Hybrid whale and particle swarm optimization

articleTitle: An Identification and Categorization of Plastic Material using Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)

authors.preferredName: Varanasi Madhu Sri Lakshmi Sudha Mai

abstract: Efforts to reduce the negative effects of plastic trash are hampered by a lack of information on the local distribution of plastic items. Scientists have created AI-based computerized management systems, including deep learning and image processing algorithms, to enhance the effectiveness of preprocessing. Artificial intelligence allows for the automatic recognition of plastic trash on conveyor belts at landfills. Yet, it might be difficult to sort out the many shades of glass and plastic within a collection. To address this, one approach is to use a convolutional neural network (CNN) with intensive training. Due to their prevalence in everyday life, plastics such as polyethylene terephthalate (PET), polypropylene (PP), high-density polyethylene (HDPE), and low-density polyethylene (LDPE) pose a significant environmental threat and necessitate the development of an automated process for sorting plastic garbage. PET plastic is difficult to biodegrade due to its robust and durable structure, which is composed of repeating units of ethylene glycol and terephthalic acid. PET detritus can accumulate in the environment due to its resistance to biodegradation, causing harm to flora, fauna, and ecosystems. The strategy that may be utilized on mobile devices has been developed to implement this procedure in filtration plants and people's homes to address the waste management problems that plague major cities.

articleTitle: Underwater Wireless Sensor Networks Using Distributed Fusion of Optimally Quantized Estimations from Local Trackers
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Underwater wireless sensor networks (UWSNs) have come to rely heavily on localization technology due to their usefulness in a wide variety of contexts. Multi-sensor underwater surveillance has been an important area of study for both military and civilian uses. UWSNs employ measurement quantization to send data from individual sensors to the fusion Centre in order to accomplish centralized tracking/fusion despite bandwidth constraints. Yet, due to its non-linear nature, azimuth information is difficult to quantify at the measurement level. This work presents a solution by distributing the tracking and quantizing the local estimates in order to increase available bandwidth and decrease the computational burden. Yet, underwater acoustic communications have a very low bandwidth because of the temporal and geographical diversity of sound channels. Data quantization helps decrease the length of information sent from local sensors to the fusion Centre, which can help alleviate network congestion. Although quantization might lessen the burden on a network's budget, the information loss that ensues from the process also leads to subpar tracking performance. This work presents a target tracking system based on optimum quantization to address this issue. Namely, it reduces the extra covariance introduced by quantization in low-bit quantized measurements, hence enhancing their tracking efficiency. The simulation results show that our method outperforms the standard uniform quantization-based target tracking technique and that the increase in data length has a negligible impact on its performance. The proposed technique has been tested in simulation and shown to effectively reduce localization errors and reduce the burden of data transfer in massive 3D submerged sensor nodes.

articleTitle: DevOps for Edge Computing: Challenges and Solutions
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: This research work explores the challenges and solutions of implementing DevOps for Edge Computing. It provides an overview of DevOps principles and practices, as well as the characteristics of Edge Computing. The integration of DevOps and Edge Computing is discussed, highlighting the benefits and challenges. The study addresses the challenges of implementing DevOps for Edge Computing, including specialized skills, limited resources, and complex infrastructure. The research methodology section describes the design, approach, and data collection and analysis methods. Case studies and examples are included to illustrate the challenges and proposed solutions. The results and analysis section presents an overview of the collected data and findings, indicating that implementing DevOps for Edge Computing can improve development speed, efficiency, and reliability. The conclusion summarizes the research findings, their implications, limitations, and recommendations for future research. Overall, this research work provides valuable insights into the challenges and solutions associated with implementing DevOps for Edge Computing.

articleTitle: Minimizing Risks in Close Proximity ARC Welding with Autonomous AI-Powered Welding System: Risk Assessment and Hazard Prevention
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Arc welding is a critical process in many industries that involves the use of high heat and intense light to join metal components. However, the process also poses significant risks to welders and co-workers, such as exposure to UV/IR radiation, high temperatures, electrical hazards, toxic fumes, and noise. To minimize these risks, this research proposes the use of an autonomous AI-powered welding system that integrates various sensors and actuators to monitor and control the welding process. The system includes UV/IR radiation sensors, temperature sensors, electrical sensors, gas sensors, noise sensors, and motion sensors that collect data on the welding environment and conditions. The data is then transmitted to a microcontroller and subsequently to a computer, which uses artificial intelligence algorithms to analyze the data and make necessary adjustments to the welding process. These adjustments may include controlling the welding power source, the shielding gas flow, the noise levels, and the workstation position and orientation. The objective of this research is to assess the risks associated with close proximity arc welding and develop a sensor-based system that can effectively minimize these risks while maintaining the quality of the welding process. The study will include a risk assessment of the various hazards and their effects on welders and co-workers, as well as a detailed analysis of the performance of the AI-powered welding system. The results of this study have the potential to make a significant impact on the welding industry by reducing the risks associated with close proximity arc welding and improving the overall safety and health of welders and co-workers. The proposed system can also improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the welding process, making it more cost-effective and sustainable for industries in the long-term.

articleTitle: Improving Library Document Resource Management and Data Sharing Through Semantic Web Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: This research focuses on the limitations of the original association rule and presents a method for addressing these limitations by dividing the dataset into event sequences. The original association rule has a limited ability to identify references related to a keyword, only focusing on the closest ones, which can lead to incomplete and inaccurate results. The proposed method overcomes this limitation by categorizing different types of references based on the research subject, which enables the identification of relevant references that are not immediately adjacent. The reliability of different categories is calculated based on the event table, and candidate records undergo procedures such as aggregation and screening to eliminate less reliable records. The feasibility of this method is evaluated by comparing it with numerous association rule processes in the marketplace. The results show that the proposed method has a significant advantage over other algorithms, with a data correlation rate that remains stable at 80%. Moreover, this study emphasizes the importance of Linked Data technology in publishing and sharing data online. Linked Data provides a lightweight and incremental data transfer model, which makes it an ideal way to integrate resources into the information flow continuously. Libraries can use this technology to become part of the internet's information resources, thereby facilitating the addition and interoperability of further web resources. The development of Semantic Web technologies allows for easier communication between humans and computers, sharing information perception specifications that greatly facilitate communication between the two parties.

articleTitle: A Review of Artificial Intelligence in Medical Prescription Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Accurate reading and comprehension of medical prescriptions are crucial for healthcare providers to ensure appropriate treatment for the patients. However, with the growing volume of prescriptions and increasingly complex medication regimens, errors can occur, which can result in severe consequences. To mitigate this issue, Artificial Intelligence (AI) can automate tasks such as medication identification, dosage calculation, and drug interaction checks, potentially improving the accuracy and efficiency of prescription analysis. This research study intends to examine the latest AI-based approaches for analyzing medical prescriptions in the healthcare industry, which can aid in the development of diagnostic systems capable of extracting patients' medical history, identifying incorrect medications and conducting statistical analyses on prescribed drugs. By analyzing the current state-of-the-art techniques in this field, one can identify areas of improvement to enhance prescription analysis accuracy and efficiency, ultimately benefiting patient care and medication management.

articleTitle: Integrating IoT and Sensor Technology for Improved Industrial Safety Measures in the Textile Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: The textile industry is one of the largest contributors to environmental pollution and poses significant hazards to human health. This study aims to utilize IoT-enabled sensor technology to mitigate the pollution and hazards caused by the textile industry. In particular, the study focuses on controlling the emission of dangerous chemicals from the dyeing process, which is a major source of pollution and hazard to human health. The study proposes the use of various sensors to monitor the environmental conditions in the textile factory, including temperature, humidity, and gas emissions. The data collected by the sensors is then analyzed to identify the sources of pollution and hazards. The results show that the most significant source of pollution and hazard in the textile industry is the emission of chemicals during the dyeing process. These chemicals, when heated, mix with the air, causing dangerous effects on human breathing and environmental pollution. To address this issue, the study proposes the use of IoT -enabled sensors to monitor the chemical emissions during the dyeing process. The sensors are integrated into the dyeing machines, and the data collected is analyzed to identify the type and quantity of chemicals being emitted. The results are used to optimize the dyeing process and minimize the emission of dangerous chemicals. The study shows that the use of IoT -enabled sensor technology can significantly reduce the pollution and hazards caused by the textile industry. The results also demonstrate the potential of this technology to improve the environmental sustainability of the textile industry. The study recommends the adoption of this technology in textile factories to safeguard the health of workers and protect the environment. In conclusion, this study highlights the importance of utilizing IoT -enabled sensor technology to mitigate the pollution and hazards caused by the textile industry. The findings of this research provide valuable insights for textile industry practitioners, environmentalists, and policymakers to promote sustainable and safe practices in the textile industry.

articleTitle: A Framework for Fault Recognition of Photovoltaic Plants with Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Emerging innovations in the usage of photovoltaic (PV) power are mostly attributable to new global regulations aimed at limiting the consumption of fossil fuels. In addition to being impacted by many types of failures, atmospheric factors have a significant impact on the effectiveness of PV systems, which can result in significant dissipation of energy during control system. This study suggests a unique approach for locating defects in photovoltaic panels that makes use of a high-resolution camera mounted on a vehicle. These devices create a lot of information which needs to be handled and examined. In this research, a new method for locating panels that can detect fault is presented. For this, photovoltaic image dataset is utilized. Then, pre-processing is done to eliminate the noise and normalize the images. For the purpose of creating a reliable detection framework, a unique convolutional neural network is combined. During the examination, fault diagnosis is made possible by the automated processing of the data that are collected. By validating the performance metrics of proposed method with other techniques, it performs well than others. The findings reveal an overall accuracy of 99.43% for the developed technique.

articleTitle: Enhancing System Stability with FACTS Devices Using Deep Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: The implementation of FACTS-enabled devices has been widely adopted in power systems to enhance their stability and reliability. However, construction of FACTS devices and a means of controlling them would need a significant amount of expertise and can be time-consuming and expensive. There has been a surge of curiosity around the application of artificial intelligence techniques such as neural networks to enhance the design and control of FACTS devices. Using a deep neural network, this research study presents a novel method to improve the stability of power systems using FACTS devices. The proposed approach involves training a deep neural network model using historical data on power system operation and stability. The trained neural network is then used improving the control parameters FACTS instruments in real-time to improve system stability. Here, we assess how well the planned approach on a test system and compare it to traditional control methods. Our According to the findings, the suggested method is able to provide superior system stability and faster response times compared to traditional control methods. Overall, our study highlights the potential of using neural network algorithms to enhance the design and control of FACTS devices in power systems, leading to improved stability and reliability of the grid.

articleTitle: Automatic Toll Collection using Vehicle Number Recognition System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: With an increasing number of on-road vehicles, there is an increasing need to save time for drivers and travelers without waiting in long lines or stop at every toll booth. This research study intends to develop an upgraded FasTag system, which eliminates the need for toll booths. The proposed automated toll collection system is developed by using vehicle number recognition, which reads vehicle license plates from images using OpenCV and Tesseract OCR Engine. This can be accomplished via human agents or highly advanced smart technology that recognizes automobiles in real-time environment based on the license plates. The proposed technology detects number plates, identifies the vehicle based on the license plate number, and then sends the appropriate toll amount as an SMS to the car owner for payment purpose.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Side Channel Secured PRESENT Light Weight Cipher for Smart Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) is a community of interconnected gadgets that could alternate records over the Internet without human intervention. The smart life did have many advantages, but it also had security vulnerabilities which are exploited by code breakers to violate security standards. Side channel attacks are dangerous attacks that work mainly using device operation characteristics like power used, noise, magnetic fields, etc. IoT devices commonly use lightweight cryptographic algorithms because of their less complexity, which makes them an obvious target for attacks. PRESENT, a lightweight block cipher algorithm was primarily created for these IoT applications which have resource limitations. Several Countermeasures have been Identified at various levels of Abstraction. The Masked-Tdpl (m-Tdpl)is one such new gate-level technique resistive against DPA and fault attacks. In order to maintain the algorithm as lightweight, the security overhead on the implementation of PRESENT using the proposed design is reduced by various optimization techniques. The PRESENT algorithm is implemented using the proposed technique using Cadence 180 nm Technology and the results were analyzed. The Number of Gates consumed is reduced by 3.5 % respectively. In addition to that, Using the proposed technique flexible key scheduling structure for Overall Physical Hardware Implementation of PRESENT with less gate Equivalent has been proposed.

articleTitle: Processing and Modification of Blockchain Transactions
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Blockchain technology has become increasingly popular in recent years, particularly in the realm of digital currencies such as Bitcoin. Blockchain transactions are processed and modified through a complex and decentralized system that involve various nodes, miners and validators. This article gives a general overview of how blockchain transactions are processed and modified, including the verification process for transactions, the creation of blocks, and the role of miners in the mining process. Additionally, this paper explores the reasons for modifying blockchain transactions, such as updating the protocol, correcting errors, and resolving conflicts. The challenges associated with modification, including achieving consensus, mitigating security risks, and obtaining community agreement, are also discussed. Finally, future research directions and final thoughts on blockchain transaction processing and modification are presented. Understanding the intricacies of blockchain transaction processing and modification is critical to harnessing the power of this innovative technology, and this research work provides a foundation for further exploration and development.

articleTitle: Secure Forgery Detection in Android Malware Applications with Trust Analysis in Google Play
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: With the widespread use of Android devices, the threat of malware applications has become a serious concern for both individuals and organizations. This research study proposes a novel methodology for safe forgery detection in malware applications for Android using machine learning and behavioral analysis techniques. The proposed methodology involves feature set extraction, pre-processing, and classification steps to accurately detect Android malware applications while minimizing false positives. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed methodology outperforms existing state-of-the-art techniques in terms of accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score. The methodology was also able to accurately detect a wide range of malware types, including previously unknown or zero-day malware. Our study highlights the importance of using advanced technologies and innovative approaches to detect and prevent Android malware, and suggests that future research could investigate additional machine learning algorithms and behavioral analysis techniques to improve detection accuracy. As the prevalence and sophistication of Android malware continue to increase, it is critical that researchers and practitioners work together to develop effective and reliable methods for detecting and preventing these threats. By doing so, users and organizations can be protected from the harmful effects of Android malware, and ensure the ongoing security and integrity of the Android ecosystem.

articleTitle: Efficient Multi Authority Attribute Based Signcryption
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: The security of data kept in the cloud has been an issue of great concern in recent years. The data is taken from the system regardless of how robust the protection is. One of the most significant areas of study in the cloud storage industry has been the development of efficient fine-grained access methods. Confidentiality and authenticity for any type of data are provided via Attribute Based Encryption (ABE) and Attribute Based Signature (ABS). Attribute-Based Sign-Cryptography is a synthesis of these methods (ABSC). Many proposed fixes, however, fall short when applied to actual problems. This method has a high computational and communication cost and uses fewer third-party services. As a result, this research study develops a unique ABSC method to safeguard both the signcryptor's and the ciphertext's privacy while allowing public verification of the cipher's authenticity.

articleTitle: Edge Computing: Architecture, Implications and Future with Latest Trends
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: As a result of the proliferation of Internet-connected smart devices brought about by the explosive growth of the Internet of Everything (IoE), lower bandwidth load, slower response, bad security, and poor privacy are just some of the issues that have arisen with data growth. Edge computing solutions have arisen as a response to the limitations of traditional cloud computing in meeting the data processing demands of modern societies. Edge computing, the new era of distributed computing, differs from cloud computing in that it places greater emphasis on being physically proximate to both the user and the data itself. The primary focus of this article is a critical examination of the associated literature and findings around edge computing. Edge computing is first briefly compared with cloud computing. Then, briefly discuss edge computing's architecture, followed by major challenges with edge computing and ending with latest trends with edge computing.

articleTitle: An Effective Application of Deep Learning in the Early Diagnosis of Stroke
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Stroke constitutes one of the primary reasons for death and severe weakness that affects millions of people worldwide and has a significant chance of developing into a pandemic in the coming years. Early diagnosis and fast treatment decisions are crucial in preventing paralysis, brain death, and other severe consequences of this condition. ML algorithms have been widely used to diagnose, analyze, and predict this disease, but there are data quality difficulties because the resources utilized to obtain the data are spread across multiple institutions. Hence, the deep learning framework with CNN is demonstrated in this paper. This technique makes use of a multimodal stroke dataset that is accessible to everyone in the Kaggle repository. 6100 MRI images are gathered for this process. The collected images contain noise and are of bad quality. So, the Weiner filter is utilized for pre-processing phase to remove the noise. Then, the watershed technique is employed for the segmentation process. Subsequently, Lion Optimization Algorithm is utilized for extracting the features. Lastly, CNN has been applied for the classification. By validating the performance measures, the LOA-CNN technique seems to be higher than the current techniques. The results demonstrated that the presented method achieves precision, accuracy, and recall rates of 99.32%, 99.52%, and 99.67%, respectively.

articleTitle: Cognition-Based Spectrum Sensing Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Cognitive radio is a cutting-edge approach that aims to maximize the utilization of wireless communication network spectrum. It encompasses several crucial functions such as spectrum detection, management, mobility, and sharing. Through the application of spectrum sensing techniques, cognitive radios can optimize the usage of available spectrum resources. In contrast to inconsistency detection, which does not require prior knowledge of the primary user's signal, consistent detection necessitates knowledge of all components of the primary user's signal before detection. To address the challenge of randomly modeled Primary User (PU) signals with uncertain power, a new spectrum detection method for cognitive radio (CR) is introduced. Additionally, due to the dynamic nature of the primary user, multiple state changes in the channel are expected during detection. To tackle this, a novel method called SNR-based energy detection (S-ED) is proposed to detect randomly and dynamically modeled PUs. S-ED utilizes samples only between the Last State Change Point (LSCP) of the PU and the end of the detection period, instead of employing all data samples observed throughout the detection interval. The suggested detection method demonstrates a significant improvement in recognizing PUs with random and dynamic patterns. Furthermore, this study introduces an adaptive local spectrum detection method that allows cognitive radio to employ energy detectors for spectrum detection based on estimated, pre-computed signal-to-noise ratios (SNR) for accessible channels. Simulation results validate that this method yields reliable outcomes compared to energy detection, with the added benefit of shorter average detection time.

articleTitle: Detection of Brain Tumor from MRI Images Using VGG-16 CNN Model with Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Brain tumors are a serious health concern caused by the abnormal growth of cells in or around the brain. These tumors can either be benign or malignant. Few of the causes for Brain tumors are genetic mutations, exposure to radiation, or environmental factors. Early detection of brain tumors is essential for effective treatment and improved patient outcomes. To address this, a novel approach has been proposed for brain tumor detection using transfer learning with the VGG-16 convolutional neural network (CNN) architecture. By leveraging the pre-trained VGG-16 model on the ImageNet dataset, which provides a broad range of data for learning and representing complex features of various objects, meaningful features can be extracted from MRI scans and differentiate between tumor and normal tissue accurately. This refined VGG-16 model can provide a more precise and reliable diagnosis, which is crucial for successful treatment. This research study demonstrates that the utilization of VGG-16 model for brain tumor diagnosis can provide an efficient and accurate method for identifying brain tumors. Moreover, this approach can be applied to develop automated systems to assist medical professionals in diagnosing and treating brain tumors more effectively.

articleTitle: FPGA Implementation of Textural Feature Extractor and Distance Based Classifier for Multi Modal Biometric Pattern Recognition System Using Multi Resolution Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: The design of biometric pattern recognition with better accuracy, high robustness and good permanence is a significant design issue in pattern recognition system. A pattern recognition system in which the biological and physiological traits of the user are employed to authenticate the users is known as biometric pattern recognition system. Unimodal biometric systems do not have the required characteristics like solidity, circumvention and permanence. When noisy data acquired from the sensor is given as input, the uni modal biometrics system's accuracy may reduce. Besides the noisy input, less variation of parameters of input data belonging to same class may be a cause for decrease in accuracy of the system. Several such limitations may be removed by applying input data from multi biometric sources. In this work, the design of a textural feature extractor and the classifier for a bimodal biometric system is described. The bimodal biometric system is constructed by fusion of iris code vector and palmprint code vector at feature level. In iris pattern, using the gray level dependent matrix values obtained from wavelet packet decomposed sub-images, the features are extracted Using gabor kernel, features are extracted from the palmprint pattern. The feature vector is formed by the concatenation of both the features after normalization is employed. By binarisation, the binary feature vector is created Using Hamming Distance and its variant, the classifier produces the classification result. The RTL description of the Hamming Distance Classifier (HDC) is written using VHDL 2008 language, Verilog HDL, and the implementation is performed on Spartan 6 FPGA. With a speed grade of 4, the propagation delay of the critical path is 330.12 ns. The obtained delay is sufficient for implementing the classifier as an off-chip design for real-time implementation.

Author Keywords: Bi modal biometric pattern recognition system

articleTitle: A Stock Market Trends Analysis of Google using Convolutional Neural Network based Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: In this study, the convolutional neural network (CNN) based google stock market prediction has been performed. Later, the proposed model is evaluated Google stocks and the performance is compared with the LSTM RNN model. The LSTM RNN model makes use of a variety of distinct measurements and architectural designs; they are all put to the test to determine which ones are the most successful. An inquiry into the impact of shifting trends and the attitude of customers towards stock prices is described in the concluding portion of the report on the study. As a result of the fact that the sentiment of customers and the trends of the market can have a major impact on the movement of stock prices, it is essential for financial analysts to keep this subject front and center in their minds. This research project seeks to provide an outline of the potential uses of LSTM-RNN models in portfolio management for stock market predictions. If financial analysts make use of natural language processing (NLP) strategies and a variety of deep learning models, they will be able to better capture the stochastic and unexpected nature of financial data and produce more accurate predictions regarding stock prices.

articleTitle: Smart Industrial Automation System Using Logical Sensors with IoT Assistance
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: In recent times, each and every individual requires an automation to do the things in smart way. The term Internet of Things (IoT) rule the present digital world in intense manner, in which it provides ability to users to control as well as accumulate the readings from the local entity to the remote cloud server using WiFi service. In this proposed work, a novel industrialautomation system is designed with bidirectional ability like controlling the industrial electrical loads as well as accumulate the present scenario of the industry by using different sensors and store that into the remote cloud server for further verification. All the details are shown in the connected LCD display unit for local entity reference. The ESP8266 controller is used in this work, in which it consists ofinbuilt Wi-Fi unit to carry the entire operation in smooth manner.In addition to the mentioned things, the proposed work allows the user to control the industry by means of remote load controlling procedures, in which the operations are done through voice-based triggers. All the accumulated sensor readings are assembled into the web server and the user can verify that anytime from anywhere without any delay by using their mobile or laptops. For all the entire proposed work is helpful to the industry to automate the activities in nice manner without any interruption as well as the outcome of this system shows the evidence to the efficiency of the proposed work.

articleTitle: Analysis for Designing a Symptom-Based Health Improvement System Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Healthcare providers are under more and more pressure to save costs and improve patient outcomes. The creation of symptom-based health improvement systems that make use of machine learning algorithms is one such strategy for reaching goals. The proposed methods employ supervised and unsupervised machine learning techniques to discover patterns and associations between symptoms and probable medical diseases. Based on each patient's unique symptom profile, the system seeks to provide them with individualized advice. The system's ability to recognize probable medical problems based on symptom patterns has been tested using a huge dataset of patient records. The technology strives for high accuracy rates in recognizing probable health issues and gives patients personalized advice depending on their symptoms. Furthermore, it helps in reducing healthcare expenses by identifying potential health conditions at earlier stages, which can help prevent unnecessary treatments and hospitalizations, as well as by providing insights into symptom patterns and relationships between symptoms and potential health conditions, which can help healthcare providers make more informed decisions. This research analyzes those proposed solutions in brief and presents us with an insight into the number of works and research done on the topic of symptom-based health improvement systems.

articleTitle: Feature Extraction Techniques in Sentiment Analysis Using Deep Learning: A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Text mining and information retrieval are fundamentally dependent on the selection of text feature items. Features must be created manually for use in traditional feature extraction methods. While it may take a lot of effort to manually build an effective feature, deep learning makes it possible to automatically learn new representations of successful features from training data in the context of new applications. Text mining has made a lot of progress thanks to deep learning, which is a new way to find features. Deep learning is different from more traditional methods because it automatically learns features from large datasets, while the latter adopts handcrafted features, which rely heavily on the prior knowledge of designers and thus make it nearly impossible to take advantage of large datasets. Feature representation in deep learning may be automatically taught using big data, which typically consists of millions of parameters. This thesis starts with a brief overview of the most common ways to extract text features. It then talks about the widespread use of deep learning methods in text feature extraction and their applications. Finally, it makes some predictions about the future of deep learning's role in feature extraction.

articleTitle: Using Artificial Intelligence to Enhance Hazard Assessment and Safety Measures in Petrochemical Industries: Development and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: The use of artificial intelligence has revolutionized many industries and has the potential to greatly enhance hazard assessment and safety measures in petrochemical industries. In this research, the aim was to develop and analyze a system that utilizes temperature, pressure, pH and vibration sensors connected to an Arduino board to detect and predict hazards. The collected sensor data is processed using AI algorithms to identify patterns and anomalies that may indicate a potential hazard. The system also includes an IoT display that displays the sensor readings at equal intervals of time, providing real-time monitoring of the environment. In addition, the system is equipped with a buzzer that sounds an alarm when any of the sensor readings exceeds the maximum limit, providing a visual and auditory alert to potential hazards. The results of this research demonstrate the effectiveness of using artificial intelligence for hazard assessment and safety measures in petrochemical industries. The system accurately detects and predicts hazards, providing critical information to petrochemical workers and allowing them to take appropriate measures to mitigate the risk. The real-time monitoring and alarm system also enhances the overall safety of the environment, as workers are quickly alerted to potential hazards. Furthermore, the system provides valuable insights into the performance of the sensors and AI algorithms, allowing for further optimization and improvement.

articleTitle: Establishing Mesh Network to Transfer and Visualize Data for Safety of Underground Miners
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Mining is a vital part of the Indian economy. While the mining sector's GDP contribution fluctuates from 2.2% to 2.5%, it contributes between 10% and 11% of the GDP of the whole industrial sector. The present scenario for miners' safety is a major issue for the world's mine operating organizations due to various underlying hazards. A safety monitoring and smart system are essential in the mining industry to avoid any kind of adverse occurrence and to enhance miners' safety and efficiency. This might be accomplished by creating a wearable that comprises several sensors that detect safety parameters and transmit the data to the network. The research's primary goal is to create a wireless system for coal miners utilizing a LAN network employing numerous ESP modules in a mesh topology. This system will allow centralized management to monitor real-time environmental parameters and take pre-emptive steps. This may be done using third-party software or an offline website. The proposed work provides a real-time ESP-based wireless multi-node network monitoring system that is technologically advanced, with minimal latency, high accuracy, and high reliability when compared to the available wired monitoring system for underground mines. In addition to that, the work also provides a simplified interface for the display of acquired data.

articleTitle: Innovative Method for Accident Prevention in Construction Sites with Virtual Reality Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Construction sites are prone to accidents, resulting in loss of life, injury and property damage. To tackle this issue, a sensor-based warning system has been developed to alert construction workers of potential hazards in real-time. The system employs GPS and proximity sensors integrated with the Internet of Things (IoT) concept to detect the presence of workers under load lifting areas by cranes. Additionally, a virtual reality environment has been created to analyse various strategies for avoiding accidents on construction sites. The proposed system offers several advantages over traditional accident prevention methods. First, the real-time warning system provided by the sensors ensures that workers are alerted of potential hazards in a timely manner, reducing the risk of accidents. Second, the virtual reality environment allows for a detailed analysis of various scenarios, providing insights into the best ways to avoid accidents. This information can then be used to develop standard operating procedures and training programs for workers. Moreover, the IoT integration enables remote monitoring of the construction site, allowing supervisors to keep track of worker safety and respond quickly in case of an emergency. The use of GPS and proximity sensors also eliminates the need for manual checks, making the system more efficient and reducing the risk of human error. In conclusion, the proposed system provides a comprehensive solution to prevent accidents in construction sites by combining real-time warnings, virtual reality analysis, and IoT technology. The system offers a range of benefits, including improved worker safety, increased efficiency, and reduced risk of human error.

articleTitle: Assessing BigBirdPegasus and BART Performance in Text Summarization: Identifying Right Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: In the past few years, automatic text summarization has risen as a key instrument for shrinking voluminous documents. This research study scrutinized the efficacy of the BART Large and BigBirdPegasus language models in generating abstractive summaries for biomedical scientific articles sourced from the PLOS and eLife databases. This study has employed three summarization methods and evaluated the ensuing summaries utilizing ROUGE, BLEU, and perplexity metrics. The findings demonstrated that direct summaries from articles secured the highest ROUGE and BLEU scores, while summaries derived from titles and keywords proved to be more succinct. BigBirdPegasus produced more intelligible summaries, reflected in lower perplexity scores, whereas BART Large offered summaries with superior ROUGE and BLEU scores, closely mirroring human summaries. This study emphasizes the importance of choosing an appropriate summarization technique, taking into account the particular needs and goals of a given application.

articleTitle: Study of Cloud Providers (Azure, Amazon, and Oracle) According To Service Availability and Price
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Computing in the cloud refers to a model of providing computing and networking resources on a utility-based, pay-as-you-go basis, without the need for a dedicated server or network. Many aspects of life, from medicine and education to the arts and entertainment, and beyond, are increasingly reliant on technological advancements. Here, Technology corporations play a decisive role. Both large and small IT companies have seen tremendous growth in recent years. Due to Cloud-Computing and its wonderful services, this is now feasible. In the cloud, users have an unrealistic expectation of available resources yet only incur costs in proportion to what they actually use. With the development of new technologies, the quantity of cloud service suppliers has increased rapidly, and each one has expanded its range of services. Cloud users, however, may have trouble determining which service provider is ideal for their specific requirements. We'll be looking at Microsoft Azure, Oracle Cloud, and Amazon Web Services, all of which provide cloud computing services. In order to more accurately assess available cloud computing service providers, readers of this article may benefit from examining the data presented here. Comparisons are made on a wide range of criteria, including the services and tools offered by each provider, the platforms they run on, the languages they support, the level of security and scalability, and the amount of data that can be stored in the cloud.

articleTitle: Malware Exposed: An In-Depth Analysis of its Behavior and Threats
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Any software that acts maliciously towards a user, device, or network is referred to as malware. Malware analysis consists of four fundamental processes that make use of a variety of technologies to comprehend operation and pinpoint areas for removal. In order to examine the behavior of the malware on the system, the second phase, known as Basic Dynamic analysis, is running the malware in a secure environment. Running malware in a Sandbox environment is a crucial step in the Basic Dynamic Analysis process. In order to determine which sandbox gives the greatest flexibility for running malware for research, this study will examine a variety of sandboxes. Based on the desired characteristics of a sandbox environment, a rubric was developed. Scalability, the capability to examine different file kinds, and the presence of sandbox detection evasion strategies are a few of the parameters taken into account. To do Basic Dynamic Analysis for malware analysis after examining some of the most well-known sandboxes, Norman Sandbox, GFI Sandbox, and Anubis.

articleTitle: Maximize Computational Offloading Optimization Multi-User Multi-Access Fog Computing Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: The rise of mobile services has impacted applications that require high computing power and quick responses, such as payment and recommendation systems. However, limited resources and time constraints in mobile devices lead to increased energy consumption and processing delays. By shifting computing duties from mobile devices to the network edge and enabling real-time data processing, (MEC) mobile edge computing which has been used to point out many these problems. Task dependency in real-world scenarios is a challenge because existing MEC methods mainly concentrate with respect to small-scale systems that are synchronous which deals with independent tasks. The proposed model using MEC system considers a variety of workloads, unpredictable task arrivals, and variable deadlines for the detection of malicious URL. The suggested model assesses the effects of offloading soft real-time workloads across multi-user infrastructures of cloud, where workloads may be locally performed on close by devices, cloudlets, or infrastructure cloud servers. The research suggests a number of offloading techniques that use various cloud tiers to optimize and the effective usage of the time of execution and consumption of energy.

articleTitle: Cypher: A New Innovative Application-Level Internet Protocol
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: The Internet Protocol (IP) is a critical component of computer networks, playing a crucial role in data exchange between computers. Despite the development of several IP protocols, these protocols have limitations such as asynchronous implementation, a lack of connection stabilization features, and rigid request and response structures. This research paper aims to introduce a new IP protocol that addresses these limitations by creating and implementing an open and semi-rigid stateful protocol. The goal is to provide improved performance, ease of use, and flexibility in data exchange over networks. This work involves researching and analyzing existing IP protocols, designing and testing the new protocol, and evaluating its performance and functionality. The results of this research will contribute to the advancement of computer networks and data exchange technology.

articleTitle: Age, Gender and Emotion Recognition by Speech Spectrograms Using Feature Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Speech signals are complex and dynamic signals that carry important linguistic information and ideas. The origins of human speech date back to around 300,000 to 500,000 years ago, coinciding with the emergence of anatomically modern humans. Despite the importance of speech in human communication, the accurate classification of the human voice in digital media remains a challenging task in pragmatic applications. To address the previously mentioned challenge, this research paper presents a state-of-the-art technique for identifying various speaker characteristics, including age, gender, and emotion, by analyzing sampled audio. For age and gender classification, eight different algorithms were experimented with to achieve maximum accuracy, where K-nearest neighbor (KNN) performed with the highest accuracy, and for emotion recognition, a simple five-layered CNN module was developed. Relevant features were extracted from the audio samples using different techniques to identify and classify the different speaker characteristics. Multiple datasets were utilized to perform various tasks, including the Common Voice dataset for age and gender classification, and the combination of CREMA-D and RAVDESS datasets for emotion recognition. The system's accuracy is evaluated using test samples, resulting in 79.57% and 93.26% accuracy for age and gender classification respectively, and 98% accuracy for emotion recognition. Overall, the proposed technique aims to contribute to the development of a novel and valuable tool for the audio-based analysis of human characteristics. The system has potential applications in various fields, including healthcare, psychology, and security.

articleTitle: Enhancing Maritime Safety Through IoT-Integrated High-Pressure Water Mist Fire Fighting System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: The use of fire suppression systems is crucial in ensuring the safety of people and property in case of a fire outbreak. In this research, a High-Pressure Water Mist Fire Fighting System is proposed that utilizes a combination of various sensors, including temperature, smoke, flame, pressure, leak, and IoT sensors, to detect and suppress fires effectively. The system works by detecting a fire using the sensors, triggering the fire suppression mechanism, and using high-pressure water mist to extinguish the fire. The proposed system offers several benefits over traditional fire suppression systems. Firstly, the use of water mist as an extinguishing agent provides better fire suppression efficacy compared to traditional fire suppression agents like water or foam. This is because water mist can penetrate deep into the fire, cool down the temperature, and reduce the concentration of flammable gases, thus putting off the fire. Secondly, the system uses IoT sensors to connect the fire suppression system to the internet, enabling remote monitoring and control. This enhances the safety and efficiency of the system, as maintenance personnel can monitor the system remotely and respond to any alarms or issues quickly. In conclusion, the proposed High-Pressure Water Mist Fire Fighting System offers a more effective and efficient solution for fire suppression, especially in high-risk environments like ships, industrial facilities, and data centers. The use of a combination of various sensors, including IoT sensors, enables the system to detect and suppress fires quickly and accurately, thus ensuring the safety of people and property. This research highlights the potential of such a system in enhancing fire safety and highlights the importance of continued research in this area.

articleTitle: Simulation and Analysis of Congestion in Vehicle Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Vehicle congestion is a problem in urban centres. The management of vehicular networks allows, through communication between vehicles and vehicles with the infrastructure, the detection of congestion and the dissemination of this information to help drivers change their path to a less congested route. This work describes a congestion detection method and compares it with a method from the literature. Simulations with real traffic data in Belo Horizonte were carried out. The results demonstrate that the method described in this work presents reductions of up to 17% in the average time for vehicles to detect congestion.

articleTitle: Battery Energy Management Systems in Active Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Battery Energy Management Systems (BEMS) have gained prominence in recent years as a result of the demand for renewable resources sources an imperative for efficient Mechanisms for storing energy. BEMS plays a critical role in optimizing battery usage, extending battery life, reducing operating costs, and ensuring grid stability. This paper proposes a BEMS for an active distribution network that uses Support Vector Machines (SVMs) to forecast energy consumption and generation. The proposed BEMS integrates a force or management system, as well as a battery management, which work together to manage battery energy storage and optimize energy flows within the network. The SVM algorithm is used to predict the energy consumption and generation patterns of the network, based on historical data and weather forecasts. The BEMS uses this information to determine the optimal battery charge and discharge schedules, which balance energy supply and demand, while minimizing the cost of energy consumption. BEMS is deployed as planned and tested on a simulated active circulation system, which consists of a PV system, a wind turbine, and a battery storage system. The simulation According to the obtained BEMS is useful for optimizing battery energy usage and reducing operating costs, while maintaining grid stability. Overall, this article provides a detailed study on development and deployment of a BEMS for an active distribution network, using SVMs to forecast energy consumption and generation. The proposed BEMS provides a cost-effective solution for optimizing battery energy storage and improving the overall efficiency and reliability of the network.

articleTitle: Development and Analysis of Novel IoT based Monitoring System for Fiber Reinforced Polymer (FRP) Dust Extraction System in an Industrial Environment 4.0
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: The objective of this study is to develop and analyze a novel IoT-based monitoring system for a Fiber Reinforced Polymer (FRP) dust extraction system in an industrial environment 4.0. The system is composed of a microcontroller, a dust sensor, a flue gas energy recovery system, and an IoT system. The microcontroller collects dust density data from the dust sensor, and the flue gas energy recovery system provides power to a battery from a generator. The IoT system monitors both the energy recovery system and the dust extraction system. The study was conducted in both laboratory and open-space environments, and the results were compared. The accumulated amount of dust sensed by the sensor was 29363.58 mg/m3 after three days of monitoring, and the efficiency of the flue gas energy recovery system decreased from 8.8% to 0.74% over the same period. These results demonstrate the importance of monitoring both the dust extraction system and the energy recovery system to optimize their performance and minimize the impact of dust on the environment. The novel IoT-based monitoring system developed in this research provides a valuable tool for industry 4.0. Its ability to keep track of events in real time and scrutinize data empowers a dust removal method that is both more productive and eco-friendly, lessening the environmental impact of industrial operations. This study's outcomes support the evolution of sustainable and environmentally conscious industrial techniques.

articleTitle: Iot Enabled Sensors and Wireless Networks for Efficient Environmental Tracking Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Efficient environmental tracking systems are crucial in industries and mining areas to monitor harmful gases and ensure the safety of workers. Internet of Things (IoT) enabled sensors and wireless networks provide a viable solution for continuous monitoring of environmental conditions. In this research, various sensors are utilized to monitor environmental humidity, pressure, temperature, as well as the presence of harmful gases such as carbon monoxide and methane. The collected data is stored in a web server, allowing users to access it remotely from anywhere in the world via an internet connection. The proposed IoT system also includes alert mechanisms to notify workers who are working with these harmful gases. When the system detects dangerous levels of gases, it triggers actuators to operate exhaust systems, eliminating the gases from the working environment. The system has been tested in a laboratory setup, demonstrating high accuracy in detecting gas levels and effectively operating the actuators. Alert signals, such as buzzer and speaker notifications, provide proper communication to the users in real-time, enabling them to take necessary precautions. The research article emphasizes the importance of IoT-enabled sensors and wireless networks in environmental tracking systems for industries and mining areas. The ability to remotely monitor environmental conditions and harmful gas levels through a web server empowers users with real-time information for proactive decision-making. The alert mechanisms and automated exhaust operation based on gas levels significantly improve the safety of workers, minimizing their exposure to hazardous gases. The laboratory testing results showcase the effectiveness of the proposed system in detecting responses and ensuring efficient communication with users

articleTitle: Privacy Preservation in Federated Learning: its Attacks and Defenses
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: In the context of artificial intelligence, the traditional centralized server-based machine learning model training approaches have significant security and privacy issues. The federated learning (FL) approach was created to address these problems. FL uses a privacy-by-design architecture, in which several devices work together to develop any machine learning system that does not reveal users' personal information under the control of a single server. In federated learning, privacy preservation is achieved through several techniques that involve adding noise, secure aggregation, local training, and model compression. These techniques aid in making sure that raw data is not transmitted over the network and that only the required information is shared to train a global model. This research study has discussed about the federated learning-related privacy threats and defenses. The existing research works are divided into two types as attack methods and corresponding defense mechanism and further analyzed the relevant research papers from the last few years, and then further discussed the research challenges, and finally concluded the research study.

articleTitle: Detection of Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy from Echocardiography: A Survey of Current Approaches
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) is a genetic disorder characterized by the thickening of the heart walls, which can lead to heart failure and other complications. Echocardiography is a non-invasive diagnostic tool that can be used to detect HCM. In this study, we survey the existing approaches for detection of HCM from echocardiography. We reviewed the literature on various techniques used to analyze echocardiogram videos and images, including traditional image processing methods, machine learning techniques, and deep learning methods. We also discussed the advantages and disadvantages of each approach, as well as the challenges that need to be addressed in the future. The results of this study show that deep learning methods, particularly those based on convolutional neural networks (CNNs), have shown promise for the detection of HCM from echocardiography. However, further research is needed to improve the performance of these methods and to make them more widely applicable in clinical practice. Overall, this study provides a comprehensive overview of the current state of the art in HCM detection from echocardiography and highlights the areas that require further research.

articleTitle: Analysis of Communication Protocols with Machine Learning for Smart Cities
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: This study focuses on addressing the communication protocols of the medium access control layer, known as MAC. Among the best-known protocols are the ALOHA protocols, in their pure and slotted version (S-ALOHA) and the carrier-sensing media access protocols known as CSMA (Carrier Sense Multiple Access) in its different versions; which have been the basis for the development of different communication standards. Currently, there are multiple versions of the classic protocols of this layer that have achieved and demonstrated an improvement to the performance presented in the base protocols, and new strategies are continuously proposed according to the technologies that emerge each year. In addition, its use continues to be valid for certain applications, being even necessary for the request of bandwidth channel resources for sending a high volume of information, as is the case of control channels and random access from cellular systems.

articleTitle: Disease Prediction Using Random Forest Classifier by Machine Learning Application
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: Accurate disease prediction is a critical task in healthcare, yet it can be particularly challenging due to the complexity of the human body and the multitude of factors that contribute to the onset of various diseases. Fortunately, machine learning algorithms such as the random forest classifier have been shown to be valuable tools in predicting diseases. This research study aims to explore the application of random forest classifiers in disease prediction, specifically by analyzing their performance in predicting different types of diseases using various symptoms. Our study found that the random forest classifier is a powerful and reliable tool for disease prediction, producing precise and trustworthy results. With its proven efficacy and versatility, the random forest classifier is poised to become an essential part of the disease prediction toolkit for healthcare professionals.

articleTitle: An Image Encryption Model Using Hyper Chaotic Map Dependent Grey-Intelligent Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: With the rapid growth of technologies and scientific innovations, information sharing was made digital, like text messages, file sharing, and pictures and audio messages especially, digital images have been found widely in economics, politics, education, and some other important fields. Methods to securely as well as secretly transmit and store digital images, particularly those that contain private information, have thus become an important concern in those domains. Image encryption technology is one to ensure the safety of image information, as it provides a pattern that is effective for people in transferring and receiving securely over a network. In this research, the Hyperchaotic map image encryption algorithm is proposed based on Grey-intelligent optimization. The optimal range of chaotic parameters in the model offers the secret image excellent security as well as with hyper-hybrid mapping, chaos encryption is used to encrypt the secret image. The proposed method achieved an improvement of 18.08% for MSE, 3.47% for PSNR, 18.55% for RMSE, and 0.33% for SSIM, demonstrating the model's efficacy and excellence of the research.

articleTitle: A Secured RSA Algorithm Based Healthcare Monitoring System for IoT Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Social Networking (ICPCSN)
abstract: In the modern world, each and every individual requires a smart and innovative gadget to carry over the day-to-day activity in easier manner. The logical evaluation of human health conditions in periodical manner is a complex thing in medical field.
